gxcuit/DNSnitch.content: # 滴水不漏 DNSnitch Clash / mihomo 配置 DNS 泄露检测。 名字的来历：「滴水不漏」是这个工具想帮你做到的事，「滴」也正好念作 D，算是给 DNS 留了个位置。英文名是 DNS 和 snitch（告密者）的合写，泄露的 DNS 就是那个替你告密的家伙。程序名统一用小写的 `dnsnitch`。 开着代理看 YouTube，流量确实走了节点，但运营商照样可能知道你在访问 `www.youtube.com`。问题通常出在配置的几处写法上，它们让本该走代理的域名先在本地查了一次 DNS。下面先说泄露是怎么发生的，再说这个工具怎么用，以及它给出的风险等级怎么理解。 ## DNS 泄露是怎么回事 正常情况下，mihomo 判断 `youtube.com` 要走代理后，会把域名原样交给代理节点，由节点那边去解析。本地网络上不会出现任何关于 `youtube.com` 的 DNS 查询。 如果这个域名在本地被查了一次，哪怕最后流量还是走的代理，收到这次查询的一方也已经知道你要访问 YouTube 了。至于谁能看到，要看查询发给了谁： - 发给 `8.8.8.8`、`223.5.5.5`、`114.114.114.114` 这类明文 DNS：路上的所有人都能看到，包括运营商。 - 发给 `https://223.5.5.5/dns-query` 这类国内的加密 DNS：运营商看不到，阿里、腾讯这些 DNS 服务商能看到。 - 发给 `https://1.1.1.1/dns-query#PROXY` 这种走代理的加密 DNS：本地网络上谁都看不到。 顺便一提，很多教程说把 DNS 改成 `8.8.8.8` 就行了。但 `8.8.8.8` 默认是明文 UDP 查询，路上的人照样能看到你查了什么。 ## 常见的几种写法问题 ### IP 规则没加 no-resolve 这是最常见的一种。mihomo 的规则从上往下匹配，遇到 `GEOIP`、`IP-CIDR` 这类 IP 规则时，如果请求是域名，它得先把域名解析成 IP 才能判断。解析用的是 `nameserver`，而且这时候还不知道这个域名最后走直连还是走代理。 ```yaml rules: - RULE-SET,apple_domain,Apple - GEOIP,private,DIRECT # 没有 no-resolve，走到这一行的域名都会先查 DNS - GEOSITE,youtube,PROXY # youtube.com 在上一行已经被查过了 - MATCH,PROXY dns: enable: true nameserver: - 8.8.8.8 # 明文，youtube.com 被看到 - https://doh.pub/dns-query ``` 给 IP 规则加上 `no-resolve`，或者把 IP 规则都挪到域名规则后面： ```yaml - GEOIP,private,DIRECT,no-resolve ``` 类似的情况还有：把 IP 和域名混在一起的 classical 规则集、引用 IP 规则集时没写 `no-resolve`（比如 `RULE-SET,cn_ip,DIRECT`）、`AND` / `OR` 这类逻辑规则里夹着 IP 条件。道理都一样。 ### nameserver 里混了明文 DNS ```yaml dns: nameserver: - 8.8.8.8 # clash-verge 的默认 DNS 覆写里就有这一行 - https://doh.pub/dns-query - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query ``` mihomo 会同时向这几个服务器发查询，所以后面两个 DoH 等于白配，`8.8.8.8` 那份照样是明文出去的。规则写对的时候它暂时用不上，但只要哪天规则改错一条，就会漏。用 clash-verge 并开了 DNS 覆写的话，机场给的配置本来没问题，也会被这一行改坏。 ### Windows 下开 TUN Windows 默认开着「智能多宿主名称解析」，会同时往所有网卡发 DNS 查询。开了 TUN 以后，Clash 只能拦到发往虚拟网卡的那一份，发往物理网卡的那份直接到了运营商那里。也就是说，系统默认设置下开 TUN，一定会泄露。 专业版可以在组策略里打开「计算机配置 → 管理模板 → 网络 → DNS 客户端 → 禁用智能多宿主名称解析」。家庭版没有组策略，用管理员身份执行下面这条命令，然后重启： ```bat reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient" /v DisableSmartNameResolution /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f ``` ### 其他 - 键名写错，比如 `nameserver-policy` 写成 `nameserver-police`。mihomo 不报错，直接忽略这一段，很难发现。 - 用 `GEOIP,CN,DIRECT,no-resolve` 兜底。加了 `no-resolve` 后，这条规则对域名请求不起作用。 - 没写 `dns.enable: true`。mihomo 默认不启用自己的 DNS，规则需要解析时直接用系统 DNS，也就是明文。 ## dnsnitch 能做什么 这些问题靠翻配置不好找，几百上千行的订阅配置更是看不过来。抓包能确认有没有漏，但看不出是哪一行导致的。所以我写了 dnsnitch，读配置文件直接分析： - 不运行 mihomo，不联网，不改任何文件。 - 判断依据对照过 mihomo v1.19.33 的源码，包括哪些规则会触发解析、查询会发给哪个 DNS。 - 报告会指到具体行号，说明是哪条规则让哪些域名被解析、发给了哪个 DNS，以及怎么改。 - 在 Windows 上还能只读地检查 TUN 有没有真的开着、智能多宿主名称解析有没有禁用。 有命令行和桌面窗口两个版本。 ### 命令行 ```bash dnsnitch check config.yaml # 检查配置 dnsnitch trace config.yaml www.youtube.com # 看这个域名会被哪个 DNS 查到 …

anthropics/FlashProve.content: # FlashProve Version 0.16.0 · A research artifact: not maintained, not accepting contributions. · Apache 2.0 ## What it is FlashProve lets an AI provider prove which model answered a request, without revealing the model's weights. - **Commit.** The provider publishes a commitment ID, which [binds](guide/what-is-proved.md) it to one set of weights. The weights themselves stay secret: every published value that depends on them is masked, except a [declared list](docs/what-is-not-hidden.md). - **Prove.** For each reply, the provider's GPU produces a proof that the reply is the committed model's output. - **Verify.** Anyone can check the proof on an ordinary CPU in seconds with `cp_verify`, without the weights. ## What model it runs FlashProve runs Llama 4 Maverick at full size, with a 1,024-token context window, on a single NVIDIA H100. The prover reaches about 110 tokens/second of prefill at 24 requests per batch ([Performance](guide/performance.md)). ## What is proved The protocol's soundness is proved in Lean 4. A provider that tries to pass off output that is not the committed model's is caught, except with probability about q/2^124 + 2^-101 after q hash queries. [lean/THEOREM.md](lean/THEOREM.md) has the theorem and how to check it. ## Built to be run by an agent Building FlashProve, running it and checking its output take long builds and many exact comparisons. That work is meant for a coding agent. Point yours at this repository with: ```text Read README.md in the FlashProve repository, starting at "For agents", and AGENTS.md. Working from the repository root as an ordinary (non-root) user, build the verifier, check the stored example proof, and report the exit code and last line. Then tell me which other routes (toy proofs on CPU, small model on an H100, full size) this machine can run, and ask me before starting any of them. ``` --- ## For agents Run everything from the repository root as an ordinary user, never as root or under `sudo`. Only installing system packages needs root, so ask your user to do that. If root is the only account, create one first ([how](docs/quickstart.md#install)). Also read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the rules on reporting results. ### Hardware and software | Route | What it does | Needs | Time | |---|---|---|---| | 1. Verify a stored proof | Builds `cp_verify`, checks an example proof | Linux, bash, g++ 13+; under 2 GB RAM | build 1–2 min, check < 2 s | | 2. Toy proofs | Self-test of the proof library on CPU | Route 1, plus make and python3; under 1.5 GB RAM | ~1 min | | 3. UNCUT

The lossless, headless coding agent harness.

One 7 MB static binary, four tools, plain stdin/stdout.
No TUI. No telemetry. No silent context cuts.

Linux · macOS · Windows · amd64 + arm64 · MIT

Landing page: balanov.pro/uncut

[![CI](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Balanov/uncut)](https://github.com/Balanov/uncut/releases/latest) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Go](https://img.shields.io/badge/Go-1.26%2B-00ADD8?logo=go&logoColor=white)](go.mod) UNCUT is a tiny coding-agent harness for shell pipelines, CI jobs, containers, and agent experiments. Gezine/CivSwitch.content:
# CivSwitch

XSS toolchain for the Switch 1 edition of Civilization 7.  
Only the **1.0.0** version of the game in physical cartridge is supported.  

Every switch 1/2 firmware 20.x.x and up to current version (23.0.1) should work.  

Tested at Switch 1 fw 22.5.0, Switch 2 fw 20.4.0 and 23.0.1  

Two components:

- **PicoSwitch** — clean, compilable Pico firmware (RP2040 + RP2350) that types a chat-XSS payload into the Switch (USB HID macro).

  Default payload = the Remote JS Loader bootstrap (exploit core + TCP loader).

  Ships with `compress.js` (chat transport: terser -> deflateRaw -> base-25 chunked `img/onerror` lines with censor armor).
- **installer-creator** — given any JavaScript payload, produces the boot-persistent installer (`XSTRIG.Civ7Save` trigger written to savedata) to send through the Remote JS Loader.

## Layout

`core.js` at the root is the shared payload both components build from, and `send_js.py` at the root sends any payload to a running loader.

## Workflow

[Video Tutorial](https://www.reddit.com/r/switch2hacks/comments/1xll4wf/civswitch_hack_start_to_finish/) from switch2hacks reddit

1. **Build + flash** the loader UF2 (see PicoSwitch/README.md).

   On the Switch, go to "System" menu and change system language to English(US).  
   Go to "Controllers & Accessories" menu and change USB Keyboard to English(US).  
   
   These are required to type "English" letters (code) using USB keyboard.  
   (Higher fw might not need to change system language as they support typing english without language change)  
   
   NOTE for JP-only Switch2 : 
   1. If you have another Switch, you can connect the two consoles via local wireless multiplayer and plug the Pico on the other device, allowing it to send the payload over the network.  
   2. If you're on a higher fw version (I'm not sure exact version), you can simply try plugging the Pico and see if it can type English text without changing the system language.  
   
   Connect to Internet using [90DNS](https://gitlab.com/a/90dns) to block Nintendo servers.  
   
   Then launch game and navigate main menu -> MULTIPLAYER -> WIRELESS -> CREATE GAME -> HOST LOBBY -> CHAT then plug the Pico in (in docked mode, focus the chat box first to receive Pico input).  

   The Pico types the chat XSS (~87 lines, ~20 min); the Remote JS Loader comes up on the console (TCP :9026) for that session.  
2. **Install the persistent boot trigger** from the PC: `python installer-creator/install.py <console-ip>` — uploads the save template, splices the compressed payload into it on-console, wipes `save:/saves/Single/`, and writes the trigger.
3. From then on, every boot: main menu -> Load Game -> the payload runs from savedata (and if the payload is the loader, :9026 is up at boot — and survives console sleep/wake).  
4. You can revert system language after installer finished.  

## Sending payloads (`send_js.py`)

```
python send_js.py <console-ip> [port] file.js
```

gongnyang/stickerforge.content:
[한국어](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

# stickerforge

![스티커 시트: 공냥이 캐릭터 24장](docs/assets/hero-sheet.jpg)

캐릭터 이미지 한 장을 넣으면 인쇄용 투명 PNG 스티커 수백 장이 나옵니다. Codex와 Claude Code 양쪽에서 쓰는 스킬입니다.

[![30초 데모 영상 보기](docs/assets/demo-poster.jpg)](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

[30초 데모 영상 보기](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

## 설치

```
git clone https://github.com/gongnyang/stickerforge && cd stickerforge
./install.sh
```

인자 없이 실행하면 Claude Code(`~/.claude/skills`)와 Codex(`~/.agents/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`) 양쪽에 복사합니다. `--claude`, `--codex`로 한쪽만 고르고, 이미 있으면 덮어쓰기 전에 묻습니다(`--yes`로 생략).

플러그인으로 설치할 수도 있습니다.

```
claude plugin marketplace add gongnyang/stickerforge
claude plugin install stickerforge@gongnyang-tools

codex plugin marketplace add gongnyang/stickerforge
codex plugin add stickerforge@gongnyang-tools
```

## 30초 사용법

1. 캐릭터 원본 이미지 한 장과 원하는 장수를 정합니다.
2. Codex 또는 Claude Code에서 말합니다. 예: `$stickerforge 로 이 캐릭터 스티커 100장 만들어줘` (Claude Code에서는 `/stickerforge`).
3. 사람이 세 번 확인합니다. A는 그림체와 장수, B는 시험 생성 결과, C는 최종 시트입니다.

스킬이 작업 폴더(스킬 폴더 밖)를 만들고 `spec.json`, `manifest.jsonl`, `out/`, `qc/`, `export/`를 채웁니다. 중간에 멈춰도 `manifest.jsonl`에서 이어서 실행합니다.

```
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/doctor.py          # 환경 확인
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/run.py <작업폴더>    # 실행, 재개
python3 skills/stickerforge/scripts/run.py <작업폴더> --status
```

## 동작 단계

| 단계 | 하는 일 | 사람 확인 |
|---|---|---|
| S0 | 의뢰 받기, 그림체 고정 | A: 그림체와 장수 |
| S1 | 컨셉 목록 작성, 전체 목록과 대조해 중복 제거 | 없음 |
| S2 | 시험 생성 | B: 시험 결과 |
| S3 | 양산. 동시 8개 기본, 상한 10 | 없음 |
| S4 | 자동 검수 | 없음 |
| S5 | 불합격분 재생성, 장당 2회까지 | 한도에 닿으면 장수 보고 |
| S6 | 컨택트 시트와 납품 폴더 | C: 최종 |

B 승인 전에는 양산하지 않습니다. 원본 캐릭터 이미지만 참조로 쓰고, 생성물은 참조로 쓰지 않습니다. 그림 위에 글자를 얹지 않으며, 글자가 틀리면 재생성합니다.

## 지원 환경

| 환경 | 상태 |
|---|---|
| Codex 단독 | 됩니다 |
| Claude Code + Codex | 됩니다 |
| OpenAI API 키 | 키가 있으면 쓸 수 있을 거예요 |
| Gemini API 키 | 키가 있으면 쓸 수 있을 거예요 |
| Claude Code만, 키 없음 | 지원하지 않습니다. `doctor.py`가 사유를 알려 줍니다 |

## 자동 검수 항목

`scripts/gates/`의 스크립트가 S4에서 폴더 단위로 PNG를 검사합니다. 종료 코드로 판정하며, 불합격한 장만 S5에서 다시 만듭니다.

| 게이트 | 검사 |
|---|---|
| size | 최소 크기 |
| alpha | 알파 채널과 투명 영역 비율. 알파 12 이하는 0, 240 이상은 255로 정리 |
| checker | 체크무늬가 픽셀에 박힌 가짜 투명 |
| margin | 캔버스 가장자리 여백, 잘림 의심 |
| outline | 외곽선 상태 |
| dup | 세트 안의 중복 |

사람이 하는 시각 검수는 표본 확인이며 전수 검사가 아닙니다. 전수 검사는 게이트입니다.

## 그림체 프리셋

`skills/stickerforge/styles/`에 여섯 개가 있습니다. 기본값은 original-match입니다.

| 프리셋 | 내용 |
|---|---|
| original-match | 원본 그림체를 그대로 유지하고 포즈만 새로 그림 |
| chibi-soft | 큰 머리, 작은 몸, 부드러운 파스텔 |
| flat-vector | 여섯 색 이하의 단색 면, 그라데이션 없음 |
| mono-ink | 잉크 한 색, 단색 인쇄용 |
| toy-3d | 비닐 장난감 같은 부드러운 3D |
| retro-mission-patch | 자수 패치 느낌의 배지 |

![같은 컨셉 두 개를 원본 그림체, 터미널, 흑백으로 그린 비교](docs/assets/style-compare.jpg)

위 비교는 컨셉 두 개(위, 아래 줄)를 왼쪽부터 원본 그림체, 터미널 풍, 흑백 잉크로 그린 것입니다.

## 인쇄 안내

Codex 내장 이미지 도구에는 크기 인자가 없어 결과가 1254-1536px 근처입니다. 300dpi로 인쇄하면 한 변 기준 약 10-13cm입니다(1254px는 10.6cm, 1536px는 13cm). 그림이 캔버스의 70-90%를 차지하므로 실제 인쇄 크기는 이보다 작습니다. 50mm 스티커는 내용 약 590px이면 되어 충분합니다. 100mm를 넘는 큰 스티커는 300dpi에 못 미칠 수 있습니다. 이때 업스케일로 숨기지 않고 실제 dpi를 알려 줍니다. 더…

# 普号注册

纯协议的 Adobe 普号注册机。不打开浏览器，直接按接口建号、登录。

交流 QQ 群：727682537

## 成品

`成品` 目录是可以直接运行的完整程序。双击 `成品/普号注册.exe`。

请整目录一起使用。exe 旁边需要 `data` 和 `runtime`，单独把 exe 拷走开不起来。

第一次打开会检查 Node、Python、协议和设备指纹。邮箱和设置写在 exe 旁边的 `puhao.db`，这个库没有放进仓库。

## 打码

建号时 Adobe 会要求认图。程序把认图交给 YesCaptcha 自动提交，使用前要在界面里填写自己的打码密钥。没有密钥不能开始注册，这一步不是免打码。

代理按行填写。每次注册会换成新的 8 位 SID。

## 导入邮箱

一行一个：

```
邮箱----密码----ClientID----RefreshToken----辅助邮箱----辅助密码
```

## 从源码构建

需要 Go 1.24，在仓库根目录执行：

```
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-H windowsgui -s -w" -o 成品/普号注册.exe ./puhao
```

开发时可以：

```
go run ./puhao --no-open
```

然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:17620/

界面标题栏可以打开积分号购买和本仓库。

把需要的题材文件夹复制到 `~/.claude/skills/`，然后直接发故事点子。

如果你的版本支持导入 Skill，就导入对应文件夹；不支持就按聊天工具的方法整段粘贴。

内容较长，所以分批输出，每批开头标明进度，回复"继续"写下一批。能直接写文件的工具可以连续写完，文件结构写在 `SKILL.md` 第一章。

- **测试状态**：当前版本已在 WorkBuddy 实测通过；此前玄幻修仙版经过实际使用测试，宫斗、宅斗、年代文、系统无限流、总裁甜宠、重生复仇、职场商战做过安装校验或阶段1试跑；其余题材尚未逐一实测。

Airhand

High-performance remote desktop over QUIC · Rust + Tauri + React

English · 简体中文

--- Airhand is a single program that is both the **host** (the computer being controlled) and the **controller** (the computer you control it from). It runs on **Windows**, **macOS** (13 or later) and **Linux** (X11 desktops). A small relay server, deployed with one Docker Compose command, handles signaling and forwards traffic. The controller can also be deployed with Docker Compose as a **web console** that you use from a browser. > **Status:** under active development. The protocol still changes between versions, so the clients and the server must be built from the same version (a mismatch is detected and reported, see [Protocol versions](#protocol-versions)). ## Features - **Host by default**: after launch there is only a tray icon, no window, and no WebView is started - **Controller console**: control **several computers at once**, switch between them, or watch them all in a multi-screen overview - **Web console**: start the controller with Docker Compose and open one port in a browser; # Looseleaf

**shadcn/ui, drawn by hand.**

[kevintngo.github.io/looseleaf](https://kevintngo.github.io/looseleaf/)

![Looseleaf](public/og.png)

Looseleaf is a React + Tailwind v4 + Radix component library and [shadcn registry](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry) where every surface is paper and every line is drawn with a pen: clean outlines and solid color, with stickers and stamps when you want them. It keeps shadcn/ui's parts, props and `data-slot` names, so you can swap it in without touching your JSX. The charm is decoration; the semantics are ordinary Radix.

| | |
|---|---|
| **123 components** | every shadcn/ui part, from button to sidebar to chart, plus paper objects, marks, stickers, a sketchpad and a chat kit |
| **61 blocks** | sidebars, logins, sign-ups, dashboards, settings, pricing, chat, notes and landing sections |
| **Art** | 160 icons, 48 doodles, 88 stickers, badges and stamps, and Stubby in 15 poses, all drawn in code |
| **Kevin Sans** | one hand-drawn typeface, tuned for three roles: interface text, titles and stamps |
| **Accessible** | keyboard, visible focus, AA text, 24 px targets, reduced motion, forced colors, RTL and three densities |

## Install

Add the registry to `components.json` once:

```json
{
  "registries": { "@looseleaf": "https://kevintngo.github.io/looseleaf/r/{name}.json" }
}
```

Then add what you need:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @looseleaf/button
npx shadcn@latest add @looseleaf/login-01
npx shadcn@latest add @looseleaf/looseleaf
```

The theme brings Kevin Sans with it. To load the font by hand instead:

```css
@import url("https://kevintngo.github.io/looseleaf/fonts/kevin-sans.css");
```

```tsx
import { InkProvider } from "@/lib/ink/react"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function App() {
  return (
    <InkProvider>
      <Button>Save changes</Button>
    </InkProvider>
  )
}
```

Components land in your repo as source (`components/ui/*.tsx`, `lib/ink/*`): your code, not a dependency.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm run dev              # the documentation site
npm run build            # static site in dist/
npm test                 # vitest
npm run registry:build   # registry.json and public/r/*.json
```

Run `npm run registry:build` after changing a component, so the registry serves the new source. Pushing to `main` deploys the site to GitHub Pages.

## How it works

Everything that is drawn is one `<svg data-ink>` behind the real DOM label. The drawing is a pure, seeded TypeScript function (`src/lib/ink/recipes/<component>-ink.ts`) that writes SVG colored by CSS variables, so the same seed draws the same line on the server and in the browser. States are CSS, not React: hover, press and focus reveal layers that were drawn ahead of time. Every color, pen width and density is a token (`--ll-*`), aliased onto shadcn's semantic variables.

## License

MIT, for the code, the art and Kevin Sans. IBM Plex Mono is SIL OFL 1.1.

**团队组织与协作报告（PDF，17页）：[docs/solo-to-team-value.pdf](docs/solo-to-team-value.pdf)**

仓名：`solo-to-team-skills`  
英文副标题：**Skills for human-led AI teams.**  
中文说明：一个人统筹 AI 团队的协作技能包。  
署：**大冰发起**

> 文档状态：**v0.9-draft**，非最终发布稿，正式公开前还会改。已在多个 Agent 工具中完成实际使用验证（取得→装／配置→按名调用→产出登记行；另外当前包上八家各有一例有限任务的验收记录（真实成果→对照要求检查→人工验收）：Codex 保留此前单独验证的一例，其余七家按同一会议转写题补验，部分宿主经受阻重跑或退回修订后才通过；不代表稳定性或所有任务都能做成，调用方式各家不同（有的由使用者本人在宿主里发出，有的命令行或代点），部分宿主未保留技能加载的原始轨迹；不表示每家四个技能都逐一被调用，也不证明效果），范围：**Codex、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek Harness、Cursor、CodeBuddy、Kimi Work、千问办公（QwenWork）** 写「支持」；**Grok Bot** 写「支持，需手动配置」；**Claude Code** 结构已备、走通待补，不在首发支持之列。

## 这是什么

一个人，也能带起一支 AI 团队。

这是一套**拿得到、装得上、叫得动**的协作技能包：四支技能＋一个模板＋说明＋脱敏案例。它帮你管住「一个人总控、多个长期 AI 助手」时最容易掉链子的几件事：活派出去有人收，说「做好了」有证据，写给新手的步骤照做就成，踩过的坑留下来给下一个人用。

借鉴的是方法思路；交付的是改写后的中文协作包，外加两支原创技能，并已在多个 Agent 工具里实际装上、按名调用过。借鉴来源见 [`NOTICE`](NOTICE) 和各技能末尾的来源／借鉴说明。

技能本身不带定时和叫醒（插件清单 `hooks: {}`）：到点查、记接单／收到成果／验收、叫开工，按技能正文里的步骤，由你或你用的 AI 工具来做。

## 对我有什么用

- **一人成队：派出去的活，接得住、跟得上、收得回来。** 一条线走到底：派 → 收 → 核 → 判。每件活派出去前登记一行「待收」，写明谁在干、谁来收、谁到点查；收回来记「已收到成果」并写明结果在哪，核过证据记「已验收」才算完。登记行让还没人接的活一眼看得见；到点去查、去催，由你或宿主的定时能力来做（分工见下面「首版核心流程」三栏表）。
- **换工具，不必重学一套协作方法。** 四支核心技能的正文各家共用，方法学一次就行；每家从哪装、怎么叫、还要准备什么，按各家真实配置分别写在「各宿主怎么装、怎么叫」。
- **从一张表开始，迈出带领 AI 团队的第一步。** 主示例和登记行模板拿来就能用：先用记事本或表格把「派、收、核」练一遍。这一步练的是方法；想让 AI 助手按名调用技能，还要先装好一个 Agent 工具。
- **从真活里来。** 两个脱敏案例（日更流水线怎样改、验收链怎样抓漏）照实写了问题、改法、结果和仍没解决的地方，见 [`ops-case-notes`](skills/ops-case-notes/)。

具体能做到的：

- 活派出去之后有人登记、到点有人查；接单、收到成果、验收完成分开记，只有验收完成或授权取消才从未完清单里拿掉
- 说「做好了」之前，先有对得上当前版本的有效证据；改过或失败过的部分补核，没变的可复用上一回核验
- 操作说明写得让不了解内情的人照做一次就成；凡须本人亲自完成的步骤，只写「请本人来」，不写代做办法
- 运营里踩过的坑，留下脱敏、可复用的方法级记录（真实问题／改法／结果／仍未解决）

## 首版核心流程

一条线：**提目标 → 分工 → 交接 → 核对 → 判断**。

| 流程 | 对应技能 |
|---|---|
| 分工＋交接 | [`dispatch-accept-verify`](skills/dispatch-accept-verify/)（派出去的活要收回来） |
| 核对 | [`evidence-before-done`](skills/evidence-before-done/)（交活前要有证据） |
| 须人做的那几步怎么写 | [`beginner-ops-writing`](skills/beginner-ops-writing/)（新手操作说明：一次一步、点名唯一、写清做完会看到什么） |
| 真实弯路参照 | [`ops-case-notes`](skills/ops-case-notes/)（脱敏运营记录） |

同一件事，哪部分归技能、哪部分归你用的 AI 工具（下称「宿主」）、哪部分必须人来做：

| 流程 | 本包技能负责 | 宿主能力负责 | 须人做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 提目标 | 给出写法：做什么、结果放哪、几点交（登记行字段） | 开会话、接收你的话 | 定目标、定先后、定做到什么算完 |
| 分工 | 派之前先登记一行「待收」：谁在干、谁来收、谁到点查 | 开多个会话或子助手；能跨助手发消息的就发 | 决定派给谁；花钱、发出、删除等危险动作由人点头 |
| 交接 | 到点查、记「已接单」「已收到成果」、续期、没人接时升级、放行后叫开工 | 定时提醒、叫醒——**宿主有就用，本包不自带**（`hooks: {}`） | 宿主没有定时，就由人按点去查 |
| 核对 | 说完成前拿到对得上当前版本的有效证据（打开看、重算、照原步骤再走一遍）；核过记「已验收」 | 打开文件、跑命令、看结果 | 登录、付款、本人确认这类只能本人做的步骤 |
| 判断 | 把证据和现状照实摆出来；附同类弯路参照 | — | 放行、退回、改方向：最后拍板永远是人 |

## 怎样开始

按你的情况挑一段读，其余可跳。**不需要先读任何团队制度。** 核心技能正文各家共用，不另做 App；每家的入口和依赖不同，见下面「各宿主怎么装、怎么叫」。

### 零基础（刚开始接触 AI 或编程）

这里的「零基础」只指接触 AI／编程的起点。会写清一件事、会安排人干活、会核对结果，就已经够用。

1. 先读 [`examples/`](examples/) 主示例，再照 [`examples/walkthrough-meeting-notes/`](examples/walkthrough-meeting-notes/) 完整跟做一件小事：给定输入 → 成果 → 证据 → 验收，外加一次退回。
2. 只看一个模板：[`templates/task-register-line.md`](templates/task-register-line.md)，学会写一行「待收」、一行「已收到成果」、一行「已验收」。

# 李志 · MyGo Music 插件

在 [MyGo Music](https://github.com/egoist/mygo-music) 里收听 [nj-lizhi/song](https://github.com/nj-lizhi/song) 收录的李志专辑与现场。

[安装](mygo-music://install-plugin?repo=djyde/mygo-lizhi)

## 功能

- 首页：每日随机推荐 30 首、全部专辑、最近播放
- 专辑页、全部歌曲、李志的艺人页
- 搜索歌曲（按歌名或专辑名）、专辑，以及搜索建议
- 喜欢的歌曲、最近播放（保存在本机）
- 「随机播放」电台：全部歌曲随机连播
- 滚动歌词：来自 [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net)，同一首歌优先用所在专辑的版本（现场版和录音室版时间轴不同）

## 工作方式

- 歌曲列表来自 GitHub API 的仓库文件树，缓存 24 小时。GitHub 不可用时，退回到仓库自带的 `audio/list-v2.js`（经 jsDelivr），再不行就用上次的缓存。
- 音频和封面走 `testingcf.jsdelivr.net`。jsDelivr 不提供超过 20 MB 的文件，这些（多是现场长曲和 FLAC/WAV）改走 `raw.githubusercontent.com`。
- 歌词只取带时间轴的。约三分之二的歌能找到；串烧、器乐、翻唱和 LRCLIB 没收录的歌（如《广场》《阿兰》）没有歌词。找到的歌词存在本机，找不到的一周后再试。

## 手动安装

把这个文件夹放进 MyGo Music 的插件目录（设置 > 插件 > + > 显示插件文件夹）。

音频版权归原作者所有，本插件只是播放公开仓库中的文件。

# XMimic **Whole-body motion tracking for the Unitree G1, trained 3.5× faster.** XMimic is BlinkMimic's world-model trainer rebuilt in JAX. On four H100s it reaches BlinkMimic's target in 0.91 minutes, where BlinkMimic needs 3.19 on one; on a single H100 it is 1.3× faster. Same task, same hyperparameters, same evaluation. Paper: [XMimic: Learning Whole-Body Motion Tracking in Under a Minute](https://github.com/nico-bohlinger/papers/blob/main/2026_xmimic.pdf) (Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters, 2026). Please [cite it](#citation) if you use XMimic. ## What XMimic is [BlinkMimic](https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic) trains one policy that tracks all 40 LAFAN1 motion clips on a simulated Unitree G1. It follows SuperMimic: learn a world model of the robot, then improve the policy by backpropagating through rollouts imagined in that model. XMimic implements the same algorithm with BlinkMimic's hyperparameters (`PRESET[main]`, commit `d264658`). What changes is the machinery: - everything runs in JAX: the simulator (MuJoCo Warp through MJX), the replay buffer, the world model, the policy and the critic; - whole training iterations compile into single XLA programs, so the GPU never waits for Python; - the iteration can be split across 2 to 4 GPUs that work at the same time.

The G1 driven by an XMimic policy after 54 s of training on 4 H100s (the run's target checkpoint), replayed in MuJoCo on a CPU.

## Results Time to the same target on H100 NVL GPUs. "First ≥ 0.82" is the first checkpoint above 0.82, with failures allowed. - **On one GPU** XMimic is 1.3× faster than BlinkMimic and InstantTrack, so it also needs the fewest GPU-minutes. - **On four GPUs** it is…

# Solstice

[![CI](https://github.com/SamG-Coder/solstice/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SamG-Coder/solstice/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A real-time renderer in Rust and WebGPU, built on the same core ideas as Unreal Engine 5's
Nanite and Lumen: virtualized geometry and dynamic global illumination, running in the browser.

**[Try the live demo](https://samg-coder.github.io/solstice/)** in a WebGPU browser such as Chrome
or Edge. It downloads a 37 MB scene, and picks a quality level to suit your GPU.

![A ruined temple at dusk, firelight glowing from its doorway](docs/dusk.png)

Solstice is an independent implementation written from published techniques. It contains no
Epic Games code and is not affiliated with Epic Games.

| Multi-bounce firelight | Daylight | Cluster view |
|---|---|---|
| ![Chamber](docs/chamber.png) | ![Daylight](docs/day.png) | ![Clusters](docs/clusters.png) |

## Quick start

```bash
cargo run --release -p bake -- --quality web --output assets/web.solstice
```

```bash
bash scripts/build-web.sh
```

```bash
python -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
```

Then open <http://localhost:8765> in Chrome or Edge.

For the native viewer, bake the full scene and run it:

```bash
cargo run --release -p bake
```

```bash
cargo run --release -p viewer
```

Both viewers use **click** to look, **WASD** to move, **Q/E** for down and up, and **Shift** to go
faster. The browser page also has controls for debug views, the sun and render scale.

## Your own models

Any glTF 2.0 file (`.gltf` or `.glb`) can be baked into a scene:

```bash
cargo run --release -p bake -- --gltf model.glb --fit 4 --ground --output assets/model.solstice
```

```bash
cargo run --release -p viewer -- assets/model.solstice
```

![A photoscanned boulder imported from glTF](docs/scan.png)

*[Boulder 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/boulder_01) by Rico Cilliers, from Poly Haven (CC0), imported
with the command above. The scan is not included in this repository.*

`--fit` scales the model so its longest side is that many metres, and stands it on the ground. The
GI system works in fixed world-space sizes, so use it for models in other units or at unusual
scales. The ground is at Y = 0 when that lies in the lower half of the model, as it does for most
scans, and otherwise at the model's lowest point. `--ground` adds a floor, and `--texture-size` sets the resolution all textures are resampled
to (default 1024, must be a power of two). Textures are block compressed unless you pass
`--raw-textures`. To see it in the browser, run `scripts/build-web.sh` and
open `http://localhost:8765/?scene=model`.

**Imported:** node hierarchies, instancing, mirrored transforms, multiple materials, base colour,
normal, metallic-roughness and occlusion maps, material factors and emissive factors.

# sheeridVerify · 教学与研究验证流程工作台

[![Tests](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.15-43853d)](https://nodejs.org/) [![License: ISC](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-ISC-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**[sheeridVerify](https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify)** 是一个基于 Node.js 的验证流程学习项目，提供本地 Web 工作台、任务队列、浏览器表单交互及 HTTP 状态查询，供学校教学、学术研究和获得授权的流程测试使用。

> **用途说明：** 本项目仅以教学与研究为目的提供。使用真实平台前应取得必要授权，遵守适用法律和平台条款；不得伪造身份、学籍或材料，不得冒用信息、骗取权益或绕过资格审核。本项目与 SheerID 及任何学校均无官方隶属或认可关系，也不保证验证成功。详情见 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)，代码许可见 [ISC 协议](LICENSE)。

## 文档导航

- [快速开始](#快速开始)
- [工作台与接口说明](#使用)
- [Linux / Instabox 部署、更新与排错](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)
- [浏览器流程说明](docs/browser-workflow.md)
- [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [安全说明](SECURITY.md) · [免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)

## 功能

- 通过 fetch 读取验证状态，按当前步骤选择浏览器或材料处理流程。
- 在 Web 页面创建、排队、停止、恢复和删除任务；失败任务删除后可重新提交。
- 按配置限制并发，记录任务进度，提交后默认每 5 秒查询结果。
- 上传原始 PNG、JPEG、PDF 文件，不生成或修改证明材料；交互式真人验证由用户完成。
- 使用访问密码、会话 Cookie、来源检查及写请求令牌保护工作台接口。

## 快速开始

需要 **Node.js >= 22.15** 与 npm。从 GitHub 获取源码：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify.git
cd sheeridVerify
```

使用下载的 ZIP 时，解压后进入其中包含 `package.json` 的目录。在项目根目录安装依赖与浏览器：

```bash
npm ci
npm run browser:install
```

首次使用时复制配置，已有个人配置请直接编辑原文件。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
Copy-Item config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

Linux / macOS：

```bash
cp -n config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json
```

编辑 `config/sheerid.local.json`，设置获授权的国家、学校、`data.organization.emailDomain` 和材料来源。该文件必须是标准 JSON，**不支持 `//` 注释或尾随逗号**。网页会按姓名和配置后缀生成邮箱，仅应使用自己有权使用的真实地址与资料。`document.path` 与 `document.url` 只能填写其中一个；示例配置不包含可直接提交的真实资料。

```bash
npm run web
```

打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。本地默认访问密码为 `JenkinWoo`；对外开放前必须通过 `ONE_WEB_PASSWORD` 更换密码，并配置 HTTPS 入口。Linux 有界面浏览器需要可用桌面；完整部署步骤和环境变量模板见 [部署指南](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)。

## 测试与贡献

```bash
npm test
```

测试使用模拟接口及本地页面，不向真实验证接口提交数据。未安装 Camoufox 时会跳过浏览器相关用例；网页和浏览器改动应在安装浏览器后验证。GitHub Actions 在 Node.js 22、24 上运行不含已安装浏览器的测试。欢迎按 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md) 提交问题和改进，报告前请删除个人资料、凭据及真实验证链接。

## 协议与责任说明

项目采用 [ISC License](LICENSE)，与 `package.json` 的协议声明一致。教学与研究是项目的预期用途，不额外收窄 ISC 的开源授权范围。软件按原样提供；第三方依赖和平台分别适用自己的许可和条款。请在使用前阅读完整的 [用途说明与免责声明](DISCLAIMER.md)。

## 社区认可与致谢

本项目认可并支持 [LINUX DO 社区](https://linux.do/) 的开源分享精神，感谢社区为开发者提供技术交流、经验分享与开源项目展示的平台。欢迎在遵守社区规则的前提下交流使用体验与改进建议。

社区推广材料见 [LINUX DO 发帖草稿](docs/LINUX_DO_POST.md)，其中包含推广声明模板与 AI 辅助生成的项目介绍图片。

## 工作原理

当前命令行先用 Node.js 内置 `fetch` 查询状态，再选择执行流程：需要填写学生资料时使用 Camoufox，需要材料验证时使用纯 `fetch` 接口。材料上传保持文件原始内容，不生成或修改证明文件。

## 使用

### 本机 Web 工作台

```powershell

[![A cyber car on a mountain road at sunset — watch the film](https://cdn.moda.app/voyager/blog/vork/cyber-car-poster-2f939652f3e77c3c.webp)](https://voyager.so/vork) [Watch the film](https://voyager.so/vork): a car drives into the night as the forest turns into glowing cyan wireframe, drawn from real triangle edges by a scene shader. Changes: scaled, animated, brighter head and tail lights, wheel pose. Trees, ground and asphalt from Poly Haven (CC0). The far mountains and sky are an image-model painting on a curved 3D card; everything else that moves is rendered. ## Paste this to your agent [Install vork](#install), then paste: > Read `vork help`. Make a small scene, render a preview and inspect the image. > Refine the camera and lighting before rendering at final quality. Read the > relevant help topic when you need a feature the first page doesn't explain. A million birds, each steering itself over a lagoon. A black hole that bends light. A glowing seed placed on a real desk, lighting the room around it. These are scenes written as code and rendered on a GPU. No video model required. vork is written in Rust and Slang, with GPU rendering through Vulkan and Metal. An agent writes a scene, renders it, looks at the result and revises the code. There is no editor to drive. Most creative tools expose controls that a person can operate. An agent can also write a shader in the middle of a shot. vork gives it geometry, ray queries and GPU execution, then lets scene programs define materials, cameras, light propagation, simulation and compositing. Ordinary shots need only scene data; the programming hooks are there when the shot needs something unusual. # Pokopia Recomp

Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2) recompiled to run natively on Windows.

[Download the latest build](https://github.com/drakolordx7/pokopia-recomp/releases/latest)

You need your own copy of the game, version 2.0.1a: an extracted folder, or NSP/XCI files plus your keys. Not affiliated with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company or Koei Tecmo.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- GPU with Vulkan 1.3
- 16 GB of RAM

## Usage

1. Unzip the build and run `PokopiaLauncher.exe`.
2. Pick your dump folder (or your NSP/XCI files and key files) and press Set up. It compiles the game on your PC (about 7 minutes), then builds the shader cache (1 to 2 hours). You can pause it and continue later.
3. Press Play.

F1 opens the settings in game. Middle mouse toggles Joy-Con 2 mouse mode for placing items.

## Reporting problems

[Open an issue](../../issues/new/choose) with `pkp.log` from the session where it happened, your GPU and your Windows version.

## Contributing

- Open pull requests against `main` and say what you tested on which GPU.
- Code for this game goes in `recomp/games/pkp/` and `runtime/games/pkp/`; the rest is shared with other games.
- Building from source needs Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools or newer, LLVM, CMake, Ninja, Python 3.13, .NET 8 SDK, vcpkg with `libvpx:x64-windows-static`, Rust and Node.js. Copy the game's `exefs` files to `game\dump\exefs\`, run `recomp\scripts\build_game.cmd pkp` in a Developer Command Prompt, then `pwsh -File game-build\scripts\build.ps1`. Shaders: [tools/shaders/README.md](tools/shaders/README.md). Launcher: `npm install`, `npm run tauri build` in `launcher\`.
- Runtime tests: `pwsh -File runtime\scripts\build.ps1 -Test`.

## Credits

Built on [nxrecomp](https://github.com/drakolordx7/nxrecomp). Uses code from [Ryujinx](https://github.com/Ryubing/Ryujinx), [Mesa](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa), smo-recomp, ScarletNX, ssbu-recomp, SuperMarioWonderRecomp, yuzu, Eden, libnx, [astc-encoder](https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder), [bc7enc_rdo](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo), [libvpx](https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx), AMD FidelityFX, NVIDIA Image Scaling, [SDL3](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL), [Tauri](https://tauri.app), [Zig](https://ziglang.org) and Python, plus [Kenney input prompts](https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts) and DejaVu fonts. Licences are in `runtime/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `recomp/THIRD_PARTY.md` and `tools/shaders/licenses/`.

## License

GPL-3.0. Third-party code keeps its own licence.

majorminorlabs/hermes-voice.content:
# Hermes Voice

Talk to one of your [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) profiles out loud, through
Home Assistant Assist, on an old Amazon Echo running echo-dot-assist.

On an Echo Show, the screen follows along: what it heard, the answer as it is written, the tools Hermes is
using, and, when idle, what it is working on in the background. The screen is a web page, so you can make
it your own ([The Hermes screen](#the-hermes-screen-echo-show)).

[echo-dot-assist](https://github.com/Gamer92000/echo-dot-assist) replaces the Alexa client while
keeping Fire OS and the Echo's audio processing. Hermes Voice runs on the Home Assistant and Hermes
hosts. It connects Assist to a Hermes profile once the Echo has been set up as an Assist satellite.

```
 Echo (echo-dot-assist)          Home Assistant                        Hermes Agent
 ┌──────────────┐  audio  ┌──────────────────────────────┐  HTTPS/HTTP  ┌─────────────────────┐
 │ wake word,   │ ──────▶ │ Assist pipeline              │ ───────────▶ │ one profile's       │
 │ mic, speaker │ ◀────── │  speech-to-text (Whisper…)   │  /v1/chat/   │ API server          │
 └──────────────┘  audio  │  conversation: hermes_voice ─┼─ completions │ (SOUL.md, memory,   │
                          │  text-to-speech (Piper…)     │ ◀─────────── │  tools, provider)   │
                          └──────────────────────────────┘   reply      └─────────────────────┘
```

This repo adds only the missing pieces:

| Piece | What it does |
|---|---|
| `custom_components/hermes_voice` | Home Assistant conversation agent that sends each turn to a Hermes profile with a stable `X-Hermes-Session-Id`, so Hermes keeps the conversation. Streams the reply so speech starts early, cleans it for speech, and speaks a short fallback instead of error text. |
| `custom_components/hermes_voice/screen`, `devices/echo/screen-app` | The Hermes screen: a page Home Assistant serves with the conversation as it happens, and a small Android app that shows it full screen on an Echo Show. |
| `skill/hermes-voice-setup` | A Hermes skill: your own agent prepares a voice profile, installs/configures Home Assistant + hermes_voice, and verifies it. |
| `docs/changes-and-undo.md` | Everything Hermes Voice changes in Home Assistant, Hermes and on the Echo, and how to undo each. |
| `docs/voice-profile.md` | How to set up a dedicated voice profile by hand (SOUL.md, tools, thinking effort, separate provider). |
| `wakeword/` | Reproducible pipeline that trains a "hey hermes" microWakeWord model, plus the trained model (`wakeword/model/`). |

Everything else is existing open-source work, used as-is; see [CREDITS.md](CREDITS.md).

## How it works

- **One Home Assistant entry per Hermes profile.** The profile is selected by URL: a standalone gateway on
  its own port (`http://HOST:8650/v1`) or the multiplexed gateway route (`http://HOST:8642/p/<profile>/v1`).
- **Hermes keeps the history.** hermes_voice sends only the new user message plus t…

Open-source compliance audit for Vietnamese websites and apps. Bảo AI coding agent rà soát các rủi ro pháp lý theo luật Việt Nam và gợi ý chỗ cần sửa trước khi ra mắt.

![Demo: quét một shop cà phê và một blog tĩnh](demo/demo.png)

## Nó giúp gì?

Nếu website hoặc app của bạn có một trong các dấu hiệu sau thì nên check ngay:

- form thu thập email, số điện thoại, họ tên
- Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, ads SDK
- đăng nhập, giỏ hàng, thanh toán, đặt lịch
- chatbot AI hoặc tool AI trên frontend
- cookie banner, privacy policy, consent flow
- nội dung quảng cáo, chính sách hoàn tiền, điều khoản sử dụng

Leviidev/Henge.content:
Henge

macOS on your iPhone and iPad.

Install · How it works · Website · Releases

Download macOS, install it on the device, and use it. - **Own emulator** — iOS gives apps no hypervisor, so Henge runs the Mac's arm64 code through its own JIT, with its own MMU and devices. It doesn't use QEMU or Virtualization.framework. - **Installs on the device** — Henge downloads Apple's restore image and restores it the way a Mac does. No Mac needed, and nothing is decrypted or patched. - **Graphics** — macOS draws through a virtual GPU, and Henge replays its commands with Metal. Safari and Electron apps like Discord draw on it. - **Touch** — The screen is a trackpad: hold to drag, two fingers to scroll. Esc, Tab, Control, Option and Command sit above the keyboard. - **Keyboard and mouse** — On iPad, a Magic Keyboard or a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse drive the Mac directly. - **External display (iOS 27+)** — During a Mac session, connect a display with a video-capable USB-C cable or a USB-C/HDMI dock. The mode activates automatically: the monitor shows the Mac, while the iPhone or iPad keeps its trackpad and keyboard controls. Disconnect to return the image to the device. The existing guest resolution is preserved; older iOS versions keep system mirroring. USB-C video is user-confirmed on an iPhone 17 Pro running iOS 27 (development build 0.1/2). - **Sharing** — Copy and paste between macOS and the device, and a shared folder that shows up in Files and on the Mac. - **Fits the screen** — On iPad, a new Mac gets a screen the shape of the iPad's, so there are no black bars. On an iPhone 17 Pro, macOS reaches the lock screen in about 15 seconds. Discord installs, opens in about 15 seconds, logs in and sends messages. ## Install Sideload `Henge.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/Leviidev/Henge/releases) with SideStore or AltStore, or install `Henge.tipa` with TrollStore or TrollStore Lite. iOS or iPadOS 17 or later, on an A14 or M1 chip or newer. # Claude animation skills

Skills for Claude Code that make animations for reels, with no footage needed. You type `/map-route home to the gym, 2.8 km` and Claude writes the spec, renders the animation on your own computer and checks it against Instagram's safe area.

![The six skills, one frame each](docs/skills.jpg)

| Skill | What it makes | Try it with |
|---|---|---|
| `/zach-d-films` | **A 3D cartoon "what if" explainer.** Cartoon people, props and effects built in three.js, slow-motion impacts, a red force ripple and captions timed to your voiceover. Comes with a finished 29 s example to build from. | `Could ancient armour stop an arrow?` |
| `/stick-figure` | **A stick-figure explainer reel.** A bright cartoon world, stick people with big faces, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions, and music and sound effects made in code. Comes with a finished 37 s example. | `Why did pirates wear eye patches?` |
| `/minimalistic-graphics` | **Black-and-white line art.** Hairline steps rise, one white dot hops up them and gets an orbit at the top, with one quiet line of text. | `Every step feels small until you look back` |
| `/map-route` | **A 3D map route.** A white city, a route that draws itself while the camera follows, a pin drop, an ETA that counts down and a destination card. | `Home to the gym, 2.8 km` |
| `/breakdown` | **A 3D exploded view.** A phone comes apart layer by layer, and every part gets a leader line and a label. | `My phone, every part labelled` |
| `/graph` | **A minimal line graph.** A smooth line draws itself, and one big number counts up with its tip. Black on white, or white on black. | `0 to 100K followers in 9 months` |

See them moving: **[novitckii.com/resources/animation-skills](https://novitckii.com/resources/animation-skills/)**

## Install

You need macOS or Linux with **ffmpeg**, **Node.js 18+** and **Python 3.9+**.

```bash
brew install ffmpeg node        # if you don't have them
git clone https://github.com/artemnovitckii/claude-animation-skills.git ~/claude-animation-skills
cd ~/claude-animation-skills && ./install.sh
```

`install.sh` links every skill into `~/.claude/skills/` (so they show up as `/graph`, `/map-route` and so on) and runs the one-time setup. The setup installs three.js and Playwright into `kit/node_modules`, fetches GSAP and warms up HyperFrames.

# MyGo Music

A native desktop music player written in Go with [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo), no WebView. It plays your local files out of the box, and everything else comes from plugins.

## Features

- Local files (MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, and ALAC or AAC in .m4a and .aac) with tags, covers and `.lrc` lyrics
- Playlists, liked songs, search, albums and artists
- Now Playing with lyric stage styles, cover wall, queue, shuffle and repeat
- Notch player on macOS, tray, media keys
- Audio cache, fades on pause and seek, loudness normalization
- Session restore
- Podcast captions, written down on the device as episodes play
- English and Simplified Chinese
- Plugins can add accounts, catalogs, podcasts, stations, comments and pages of their own

## Build

```bash
go tool mygo dev     # run in development
go tool mygo build   # package into build/
go test ./internal/...
```

## Podcast captions

Episodes are written down on the device as they play, with [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx) and Qwen3-ASR, which the app downloads when the listener asks for them. The libraries come from this repository's `sherpa-onnx-<version>` prerelease, which only changes with that version:

```bash
go run ./scripts/sherpa -sign "Developer ID Application: …"
gh release create sherpa-onnx-2.0.1 --prerelease --latest=false build/sherpa/*
```

## Plugins

A plugin is a folder in the app's `plugins` directory (Settings > Plugins > + > Show Plugins Folder) with a `plugin.json` and one JavaScript or TypeScript file. Install one with the + in Settings > Plugins from GitHub, by its repository or its address, or from its folder or a zip of it on this computer, or drop the folder in by hand. Remove one from its ⋯ menu there. There's nothing to build, and the same plugin runs on every platform. [`examples/demo-plugin`](examples/demo-plugin) does everything a plugin can with made-up data: copy it to start.

```json
{
  "id": "example",
  "name": "Example",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "minAppVersion": "0.1.8",
  "main": "index.js",
  "playback": "stream",
  "permissions": { "network": ["api.example.com"] },
  "settings": [{ "key": "apiKey", "label": "API Key", "help": "From your account page", "link": "https://example.com/keys" }],
  "navigation": [
    { "builtin": "home" },
    { "title": "Charts", "page": "charts", "icon": "chart" },
    { "title": "Stations", "builtin": "stations" }
  ]
}
```

```js
export async function search({ query, kind, offset }) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&type=${kind}&offset=${offset}`, {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${host.setting("apiKey")}` },
  });
  return { tracks: (await res.json()).items.map(toTrack), more: false };
}

export function stream({ id, quality }) {
  return { url: `https://api.example.com/audio/${id}.mp3`, type: "mp3" };
}

**Find out who causes your lag: your Wi-Fi, your router, your ISP or the game server.** [![Windows 10/11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%20%7C%2011-0039A6?style=flat-square&logo=windows&logoColor=white)](#quick-start) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20with-Rust-1A1A1A?style=flat-square&logo=rust&logoColor=white)](#build-from-source) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-5F5F5F?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Portable](https://img.shields.io/badge/portable-no%20installer-0F7B0F?style=flat-square)](#quick-start) [![No admin](https://img.shields.io/badge/admin-not%20required-0F7B0F?style=flat-square)](#faq) [![No telemetry](https://img.shields.io/badge/telemetry-none-5F5F5F?style=flat-square)](#faq) [![Single exe](https://img.shields.io/badge/single-.exe-5F5F5F?style=flat-square)](#quick-start)
**Lag Doctor is a free ping test, packet loss test and jitter test for games on Windows.** It finds the server your game is actually connected to (CS2, VALORANT, Dota 2, Fortnite, Apex Legends, League of Legends and more), watches that connection live, and traces it hop by hop to tell you *where* the lag starts. No more guessing whether to restart the router, call your ISP or blame the servers: Lag Doctor shows the route as a line from your PC to the game server, colours every segment by health, and gives you a plain verdict with a fix.

## Why Lag Doctor ### Follows your real game server, automatically Start your game and Lag Doctor picks it up from the process list, reads the game's own connections and starts pinging the server it is really talking to. No IP to look up, no generic "speed test" to a server in another country. A fallback target (for example `1.1.1.1`) is used when no game is running. ### A blame meter that says who is at fault Every hop on the path is probed in rotation. Loss and jitter only count against a router when they **persist all the way to the server**, so routers that just rate-limit ICMP do not get blamed (the classic MTR reading rule). The result is a verdict you can act on: *your Wi-Fi*, *your router*, *your ISP* or *the game server*, with a confidence and the delay each segment adds.

These > builds evict unused pipelines after ~2.5 min, which freezes the game for ~20 s when a big pack is preloaded. > > **Optional warm-up** (once, and again after GPU driver updates): set the GPU's shader cache size to > 10 GB or Unlimited in your Nvidia control panel, turn preload on, boot the game, wait at the title screen until compiling finishes, > quit, then turn preload off. Every download is checksum-verified and validated; your previous cache is kept as `.bak`. ## Publishing a pack ``` lichii-sync pack -title [-prev .json] out/ - gh release create - out/ gh release upload manifests out/.json --clobber gh api -X PATCH repos///releases/$(gh api repos///releases/tags/- --jq .id) -f make_latest=false ``` Pack releases must not be marked *Latest*, or the README download button (the latest release page) shows a pack instead of the app. Upload the chunks before the manifest. # Ocarina Recomp

[Read in English](README.en.md)

**Ocarina rodando nativo no Windows, sem emulador.**

O código do jogo é traduzido para C e compilado como um programa do Windows. Os gráficos do Switch 2 são convertidos para Vulkan. Tudo isso acontece **no seu PC, a partir do seu próprio arquivo do jogo**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Este repositório **não contém o jogo, keys nem executável**, e não explica como obtê-los. Você precisa da sua própria cópia. O que a instalação gera (o `ocarina.exe`, o código gerado, o cache de shaders e os saves) sai do seu jogo: **não compartilhe**.

## Estado do projeto

Experimental. Só foi testado em **um PC** (Ryzen 9 9950X3D, RTX 5090), na região do início do jogo.

| O quê | Situação |
|---|---|
| Abertura e jogo novo, até a Árvore Deku | ✅ Funciona |
| Vilarejo Kokiri: árvores, plantas, casas, luz | ✅ Funciona |
| Som, controle, saves e vídeos | ✅ Funciona |
| Desempenho na RTX 5090 | ✅ Cerca de 59 fps parado, 51 a 55 fps caminhando |
| Travadinhas ao entrar em áreas novas | ⚠️ Ainda acontecem, principalmente na primeira vez |
| Tocar a ocarina | ❓ Correção aplicada, ainda sem teste em jogo |
| Hyrule Field e o resto do jogo | ❓ Ainda não testados |
| Placas AMD e Intel | ❓ Nunca testadas |

## Como compilar

O jogo não vem pronto: ele é compilado no seu PC, a partir da sua cópia. Escolha um destes três jeitos.

**1. Com o instalador em ZIP, o mais fácil:** não instala nada no Windows e não pede administrador.

1. Baixe o **`Ocarina-Setup-...-windows.zip`** da [página de versões](https://github.com/sostenesfreitas/ocarina-recomp/releases/latest).
2. **Extraia o ZIP inteiro** para uma pasta e abra o `Instalar-Ocarina.exe` que está dentro dela.
3. O executável não tem assinatura digital, então o Windows pode avisar. Clique em **Mais informações** e depois em **Executar assim mesmo**.
4. Na janela, escolha o `.nup` do seu jogo (ou uma pasta com `exefs` e `romfs`) e clique em **Instalar**.
5. No fim, clique em **Jogar**, ou use o atalho **Ocarina Recomp** na Área de Trabalho.

Para desinstalar, apague a pasta de instalação. Prefere conferir antes? O executável só abre o script `instalador\Instalar-Ocarina.ps1`, que está ao lado dele no ZIP e pode ser lido em qualquer editor. O [código do executável](instalador/launcher.c) tem poucas linhas. Alguns antivírus reclamam de programas novos sem assinatura e de scripts do PowerShell: é um alarme possível, e o código está todo aqui para quem quiser conferir. A página de versões traz o SHA-256 do arquivo.

> [!NOTE]
> A etapa "Preparar os arquivos do jogo" é lenta, principalmente em HD: enquanto o relógio da janela andar, está funcionando.

# satmux

TCP multiplexer and `1-RTT` HTTP/TLS relay for geostationary (GEO) inflight Wi-Fi (Inmarsat GX, Viasat, Panasonic, SITA). Pure Python 3 stdlib, zero external dependencies.

Measured inflight over Inmarsat GX Ka-band (`~620 ms` RTT, SITA `AS206433` Amsterdam ground station):

```text
  ORIGIN (6× PARALLEL)  RAW CABIN WI-FI (:443)    1-RTT BBR + ZLIB MUX    SPEEDUP
  ────────────────────  ────────────────────────  ──────────────────────  ─────────
  GitHub Repo           ████████████    TIMEOUT  ███░░░░░░░░░    4.66s  FIXED ✓
  GitHub API            ████████████  TCP RESET  ██░░░░░░░░░░    2.66s  FIXED ✓
  Hacker News           ████████████    TIMEOUT  ██░░░░░░░░░░    2.28s  FIXED ✓
  MDN Docs              ████████░░░░     12.01s  ██░░░░░░░░░░    2.30s     5.2×
  Cloudflare            ██░░░░░░░░░░      2.97s  █░░░░░░░░░░░    1.40s     2.1×
  PyPI JSON API         █████░░░░░░░      7.09s  ██░░░░░░░░░░    2.64s     2.7×
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  6-Origin Burst:    19.13s (3/6 failed)  →  5.35s (0/6 failed)   [3.6× faster · -76% TTFB]
```

## Problem

Non-Starlink inflight Wi-Fi usually breaks on three things unrelated to raw bandwidth:

1. **Onboard `:443` middleboxes and DNS interception.** Cabin gateways intercept `:53` DNS and run a transparent `:443` split-TCP proxy (PEP) whose state table drops connections under load (`Connection reset by peer` / TLS timeouts on `github.com`, `api.github.com`, package registries). Non-443 TCP ports pass through untouched.
2. **Handshake round-trips (`~620 ms` per GEO hop).** Every new origin normally pays multiple satellite round-trips (DNS + TCP + TLS) before transferring payload bytes.
3. **Cubic congestion collapse.** Cabin Wi-Fi packet loss causes standard TCP to halve `cwnd` repeatedly, leaving most of your per-seat token-bucket cap unused.

## How it works

```text
Direct (:443):
  laptop ──▶ cabin DNS + :443 PEP ══(3–4 GEO RTTs)══▶ ground ──▶ origin  (frequent TCP resets)

satmux (:8444):
  laptop ══(12 persistent TCP :8444 BBR + zlib pipes)══▶ ground VM ──(2 ms)──▶ origin
```

- **Persistent non-443 carrier pool (`:8444`):** Keeps 12 pre-warmed TCP connections open to a Linux VM near the satellite ground station, bypassing the cabin `:443` proxy and onboard DNS. Streams are scheduled onto the carrier with the lowest recent byte load so idle browser keepalives do not cause head-of-line queueing.
- **0-RTT stream open (`127.0.0.1:1080` SOCKS5 / `127.0.0.1:8080` HTTP CONNECT):** Returns `OK` locally in `<1 ms` and sends `FT_OPEN` + TLS `ClientHello` in the same TCP burst, saving one full satellite RTT while preserving end-to-end TLS from the laptop.
- **1-RTT ground fetch (`127.0.0.1:8081`):** Sends an encrypted (`BLAKE2b-512` stream + `HMAC-SHA256`) request frame over a warm carrier. The ground VM performs DNS, verified TLS 1.3, and HTTP redirects on fiber (`~2–5 ms`) and compresses plaintext responses with `zlib` before crossing the sa…

A use-case guide to Nintendo Switch 2 emulator forks and adjacent native ports: which build to pick for your GPU, OS, and the game you want to play.

[![Last verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/last%20verified-2026--11--07-blue)](#update-log)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen)](CONTRIBUTING.md)

> [!WARNING]
> Everything here is experimental. Builds land several times a day, regress without notice, and fork rankings depend on the game and driver. "Best" below means "best documented starting point for that use case on 7 Nov 2026", nothing more.

Official Eden does not support Switch 2 in its stable release. The Switch 2 builds here are community forks, not Eden team releases.

The page is ordered by what people ask first: which fork to use, what has been tested, then setup and trust checks.

---

## Which fork should I use?

| Your situation | Start here | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Windows/Linux, NVIDIA, first install | [**Djihads80/Eglantine**](https://github.com/Djihads80/Eglantine/releases) ★ | The central upstream: most tested, most builds, all-round compatibility |

# mightyCode

Run **Claude Code** on a local MLX model
([DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic](https://huggingface.co/xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic)).
No API key needed, fully local (Apple Silicon only).

```
claude  --/v1/messages-->  anthropic_proxy.py  --/v1/chat/completions-->  mlx_lm.server (4-bit model)
```

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `claude-local` | Launcher. Starts the backend as a persistent service and opens `claude` |
| `anthropic_proxy.py` | Anthropic Messages API → OpenAI-compatible API proxy (streaming and tool calls supported) + EoCC compaction + Guard hook |
| `guard.py` | Tool-call inspection (exfiltration, credential access, persistence, destructive commands) |
| `convert_model.py` | HF → MLX 4-bit conversion (quantizes on CPU) |
| `setup.sh` | Creates the venv, downloads and converts the model, registers the command on PATH |

## Requirements
- Apple Silicon Mac (macOS), 16 GB RAM or more recommended
- Free disk space: about **25 GB** during conversion (19 GB source + 4.7 GB output). About 5 GB once the source is deleted
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (`brew install uv`)

## Installation

### 1. Claude Code itself (not included in this repository)
Claude Code cannot be redistributed, so install it yourself by following the official instructions.

```bash
# Official installer (macOS / Linux)
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
# or via npm (Node.js 18+)
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

claude --version   # verify
```
See https://code.claude.com/docs for the latest instructions. You do not need to log in with an Anthropic account to use it with a local model.

### 2. This repository
A pre-converted model is available at https://huggingface.co/shi3z/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic-MLX-4bit
(skip the 19 GB download and conversion: `hf download shi3z/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic-MLX-4bit --local-dir models/heretic-9b-mlx-4bit`, then run `./setup.sh`).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/shi3z/mightyCode.git
cd mightyCode
./setup.sh
```
If you are short on disk space, put the conversion source on an external drive: `SRC_DIR=/Volumes/big/src ./setup.sh`
(If `~/.local/bin` is not on your PATH, add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"`.)

## Usage
```bash
claude-local          # start (first run takes a few tens of seconds to load the model). Arguments are passed through to claude
claude-local -p "..." # non-interactive run
claude-local status   # backend status
claude-local logs     # tail the logs
claude-local stop     # stop the backend (it keeps running after claude exits, so stop it when you no longer need it)
```

Environment variables:

| `MODEL_DIR` | `models/heretic-9b-mlx-4bit` | MLX model to use |
| `MLX_PORT` / `PROXY_PORT` | 8080 / 8082 | Ports |
| `THINKING` | 0 | Set to 1 to enable Qwen's thinking mode (slower) |
| `COMPACT_THRESHOLD` | 48000 | Estimated token count that trigg…

# lunar-for-roblox-decompiled

Decompiled output for Lunar for Roblox 1.0.16 (the Roblox launcher by
Moonsworth, not the Minecraft Lunar Client) - the Electron app, the NSIS
installer around it, and the native DLLs it ships with.

## Layout

- `src/` - main / preload / renderer bundles, cleaned up
- `installer/` - the NSIS script dumped to text, plus the uninstaller's
- `native/` - decompiled output (`.c`): `owutility*`/`integrity.c` up top,
  `installer/`, `addons/` and `chromium/` for the rest
- `docs/` - index of IPC channels/services, bundle outlines, owutility notes
- `tools/` - the scripts used to pull it apart

## Reproducing

```sh
# installer blocks + script dump
python tools/extract_nsis.py lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-setup.exe out/
python tools/nsis_dump.py lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-setup.exe script.txt

# the actual app payload is downloaded by the installer, grab it directly
curl -O https://appupdates.lunarrobloxprod.com/lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-x64.nsis.7z
tar -xf lunar-for-roblox-1.0.16-x64.nsis.7z
npx @electron/asar extract resources/app.asar app
```

Every chest you open makes the number honest.

PirateChestCounter is the community count for the Pirate Shop Token in Fortnite's Treasure Hunters season. Add the chests you open, watch verified finds land on the map, and see the one honest drop rate with the range it could really be.

Download · Why PirateChestCounter · What you get · How it works · FAQ

PirateChestCounter replaces rumors with a count anyone can see. - **One number, with its range.** The rate always comes with how sure it is, and the range narrows as more people add chests. - **Myths tested.** Each tip is compared on real counts, and the answer is the counts' own: no, likely yes, or too early. - **Finds you can trust.** A find counts only after two volunteers check the clip. ## What you get ### The count

One square for every 10,000 chests the community opened. The purple ones held a token. The field shows what "rare" means faster than a percentage does. ### Myths

DIYgod/pinky.content:
Pinky

Let any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone, from macOS, Windows or Linux, with you in the loop.

Download · Get started · FAQ · Discord

English · 简体中文 · 日本語


A real Claude Code run on an Android 16 emulator. Pinky asks before payments by default; this run also asks before messages.

Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent. - **Every platform.** One app for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux. It drives Android phones (Android 10 to 17) and iPhones on iOS 17.4 or later: nothing to install on iOS 27 and later, and a helper installed once from Xcode on iOS 17.4 to 26, which you can also choose on iOS 27 (tried there and on Simulators, not yet on a phone below 27; [details](#phones)). - **Tiny and native.** The window is drawn by [MyGo](https://github.com/egoist/mygo) on the GPU, with no Electron and no webview: a 16–22 MB download that idles at about 70 MB of memory and 0% CPU on a Mac. - **Any agent, one click.** Settings › Agents connects Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and more, and any agent that can use MCP servers works, on the same computer or over HTTP. - **Locked phone? Unlock it from your computer.** Save the phone's PIN in Pinky once, then confirm each unlock with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your keyring's password. Agents never see the PIN. - **Free and open source** under the Apache-2.0 license, with no account to create.

You approve the risky steps. Payments, trades and transfers wait for your click; in Settings › Safety you can have sends, orders, deletions, calls, installs, links that leave the app and settings changes wait too, or every step. Pinky spots these buttons in 10 languages. The rules run in Pinky's gateway, so an agent can't approve itself, even when text on the screen tries to talk it into it.

# Ram-Altman

**A bash script that writes to Sam Altman once a day to report the RAM he missed.**

Read the sample emails at **[ram-altman.lol](https://ram-altman.lol)**, no install needed.

[![Website: ram-altman.lol](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-ram--altman.lol-0f5a43)](https://ram-altman.lol)
![Global DRAM allocation: quite terrible](https://img.shields.io/badge/global%20DRAM%20allocation-quite%20terrible-red)
![Utilization: maybe 5%](https://img.shields.io/badge/utilization-maybe%205%25-orange)
![Emails: 1 per day](https://img.shields.io/badge/emails-1%20per%20day-blue)
![Written in Bash, not Electron](https://img.shields.io/badge/written%20in-bash%2C%20not%20electron-brightgreen)

There is RAM in your computer. Right now. Just sitting there, in a *personal* computer, being personal.

You may have thought of this as "a computer working normally". On a recent episode of [Cheeky Pint](https://gizmodo.com/sam-altman-youre-completely-right-about-ram-im-sorry-for-the-confusion-heres-what-happened-2000835208), the CEO of OpenAI offered another view:

> "From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer"
>
> — Sam Altman

That RAM, he added, is ["being used maybe 5% of the time"](https://www.xda-developers.com/sam-altman-says-its-quite-terrible-that-people-have-ram-in-their-pcs-during-a-shortage/).

Which raised an obvious question for a certain kind of person: *surely someone should be monitoring this?*

So we wrote a script. If your machine has more than 10% of its RAM available, it sends one email a day to let Sam know. It seemed only fair. He can't fix the problem if nobody tells him where the RAM is.

## Features

- Tracks total, used and available RAM, plus your standing with the global allocation authorities
- Handles page cache correctly, which already puts it ahead of most arguments about RAM
- Sends at most one email per day, because we're hoarders, not animals
- Rotates 8 subject lines, 10 messages and 6 sign-offs, so the joke gets old at a carefully managed pace
- Logs every sample to CSV for when the auditors arrive
- Ships with 14 tests, more than the DRAM market has had sensible outcomes
- Is written in bash, as an Electron version would have solved the problem by using all the RAM

## A sample of today's correspondence

```text
Subject: You missed a spot

Hi Sam,

Please don't be alarmed, but there is 8.6 GiB of RAM on my desk that isn't in
a data centre. That's 56.2% of what's installed here, and as far as I can tell
it has no plans today.

Hoarding responsibly,
A concerned RAM owner

--
Sent automatically, at most once a day, by a small script on one PC.
Reply if you'd like it to stop.
```

The figures are real. They come from your machine. That's the worrying part.

## What counts as "used"?

```text
used = MemTotal - MemAvailable
```

`MemAvailable` is the kernel's own estimate of how much memory programs c…

jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth.content:
# CHIMERA

A physical-modeling voice synthesizer in the browser. Every sound comes from a simulated
airway (lungs, vocal folds or syrinx, a branched vocal tract, lips, nose), not from samples.
The engine is Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for an AudioWorklet; the same code runs natively
for tests and the `chimera` CLI.

## What it does

- **Play**: drag the tongue, lips and jaw in a live cutaway of the head; vowel pad, encoders,
  computer keyboard and Web MIDI.
- **Speak**: English text (CMUdict with a letter-to-sound fallback) or IPA, turned into
  gestures and prosody, with the gestural score and a consonant chart on screen.
- **Sing**: piano roll with lyrics per note; consonants land before the beat.
- **Beatbox**: pads and a step sequencer, every drum an articulatory gesture.
- **Bestiary**: songbird (two-voice syrinx), seal, alligator and elephant.
- **Duet** (`?show=<id>`): two 3D heads replay a pre-rendered song.

Male, female and child bodies blend continuously. Everything on screen animates from live
engine state: pressure in the airway, airflow, the vocal folds, spectra and formants.

## Run it

Needs Rust with the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target, and Bun.

```sh
bun install
bun run dev        # builds the wasm, then Vite on 127.0.0.1:5317
bun run test       # wasm build, cargo test --workspace, bun test tests
```

The AudioWorklet needs a secure context, so open it on localhost or over HTTPS (for example
`tailscale serve`). Vercel builds it with `vercel.json`.

Offline renders and measurement:

```sh
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- render speech|text|song|notes|beatbox|creature|vowels …
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- diagnose       # nasal leakage, formants, bandwidths, pitch
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- compare csd    # against a real singer (docs/csd-comparison.md)
cargo run --release -p chimera-cli -- compare tsp    # against 23 real speakers (docs/speech-comparison.md)
bun tools/spectrogram.ts in.wav out.png
```

## Docs

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): the acoustic model (FDTD airway, sources,
  anatomy, gestures).
- [docs/rust-engine.md](docs/rust-engine.md): the engine's real-time and determinism contract,
  and the browser boundary.
- [docs/ui-redesign.md](docs/ui-redesign.md) and [docs/mockups/](docs/mockups/): the vector
  display look.
- [docs/csd-comparison.md](docs/csd-comparison.md): scoring the voice against the Children's
  Song Dataset.
- [docs/speech-comparison.md](docs/speech-comparison.md): scoring the speech against real
  speakers, phone by phone (the TSP speech database).
- [docs/hill-climb/](docs/hill-climb/): the rules and log for tuning the voice one measured
  step at a time.

Agents: see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Bundled third-party files keep their own licenses: the CMU Pronouncing
Dictionary ([public/data/CMUDICT-LICENSE.txt](public/data/CMUDICT-LICENSE.txt)) and the fonts
([public/fonts/](public/fonts/)).

janestreet/agent_skills.content:
# Agent skills from Jane Street

A collection of skills for AI agents and chatbots.
Each skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file
with instructions for the agent.

## Skills

- **socratic-tutor** — turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches a
  topic of your choice using the Socratic method: a diagnostic, a skill map with
  levels 0-5, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment.

## How to use

With a coding agent that supports the common `SKILL.md` format, copy the skill
directory into your agent's skills folder, then ask the agent to use it
("teach me X").

With a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's `SKILL.md` into the chat
(or into a custom/system prompt), followed by what you want it to do.

sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-beta.content:
# Boxshelf beta

**[⬇ Download the latest release](../../releases/latest)** · **[Source code (GPL-3.0)](https://github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source)** · [Source zip of the latest version](https://github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source/archive/refs/tags/v1.82.0-beta.11.zip)

Boxshelf is a TV-style launcher for your emulators, Steam games and media apps. Your games sit on a 3D shelf with
real box art: you can flip a case, open it, take the disc out, read the manual, and walk the whole collection in the
Museum. One controller runs everything.

This is a **public beta** for **Windows**, **Android** (made for the AYN Thor and its two screens) and, as an
experimental first build, **Linux / Steam Deck**. Thank you for trying it: please tell us what breaks.

> **Source code:** Boxshelf is open source (GPL-3.0). The full source is at
> **[github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source](https://github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source)**.

## Download

Every build is on the **[Releases](../../releases)** page. Each release lists what changed and what's known to be broken.

| Your device | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 PC | `Boxshelf-<version>-windows.zip` |
| AYN Thor and other Android devices | `Boxshelf-<version>-android.apk` |
| Linux / Steam Deck (experimental) | `Boxshelf-<version>-linux.AppImage` |

Boxshelf doesn't include or download any games, BIOS files or keys: you need the emulators and games you already own.

Want to read or build the code? It's in **[boxshelf-source](https://github.com/sassiestrhihno/boxshelf-source)**.

## Install on Windows

1. Unzip the download into a folder of its own, for example `Documents\Boxshelf`. It's portable: it doesn't install
   anything, and deleting the folder removes it.
2. Run **Boxshelf.exe**.
3. Windows may show *"Windows protected your PC"*: the beta isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then
   **Run anyway**.
4. The setup wizard opens. Click **Find my emulators and games** (or **I'll pick them myself**), tick the consoles

# symcache-prune

TLDR: on some Macs, `/System/Library/Caches/com.apple.coresymbolicationd` grows by gigabytes per hour and macOS
shows it only as "System Data". `symcache-prune` is one zsh script that installs an hourly launchd job which empties
that folder once it reaches 10 GB (or a size you choose). Check yours first:

```sh
sudo du -sh /System/Library/Caches/com.apple.coresymbolicationd
```

## The problem

`coresymbolicationd` is the macOS daemon that turns addresses in binaries into symbol names, for crash reports,
debuggers, profilers and test tools. It keeps a cache, mostly one file named `data`, in
`/System/Library/Caches/com.apple.coresymbolicationd`. Storage settings do not name it; it is counted as part of
"System Data". On one example machine, a development Mac running many test runs, the cache went from 0 to 9.4 GB in
about 5 hours and later reached 39 GB. Those are one machine's numbers; yours may grow much more slowly or not at all.

## Check yours

```sh
sudo du -sh /System/Library/Caches/com.apple.coresymbolicationd
ls /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/coresymbolicationd_*.diag
```

The folder is readable only by root, so `du` needs `sudo`. It only reads sizes. The same command is printed by
`./symcache-prune check`.

The `.diag` files are resource reports. macOS writes one when a process writes more to disk than its allowed budget
over a period of time. A `coresymbolicationd` report names the event as disk writes, gives how much the daemon wrote
and over how long, the limit it went over, and stack samples of the code doing the writing. If you have several of
these, the cache is probably growing on your machine.

## Clear it by hand

```sh
sudo find -x /System/Library/Caches/com.apple.coresymbolicationd -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} +
```

This deletes what is inside the folder and keeps the folder itself. The daemon rebuilds the cache as it needs it.

## Install, uninstall, status

Read the script before you run it as root; it is under 200 lines.

```sh
sudo ./symcache-prune install        # threshold 10 GB
sudo ./symcache-prune install 20     # threshold 20 GB; run again to change it
./symcache-prune status              # is the job loaded, last 5 log lines
sudo ./symcache-prune status         # the same, plus the cache size
sudo ./symcache-prune uninstall      # unload the job, remove the plist, the copy and the log
```

`install` writes:

- `/usr/local/libexec/symcache-prune`, a copy of the script (root:wheel, mode 755);
- `/Library/LaunchDaemons/local.symcache-prune.plist` (root:wheel, mode 644), label `local.symcache-prune`;
- `/var/log/symcache-prune.log`, created at the first prune.

`run [threshold-gb]` is what launchd calls. You can also call it yourself with `sudo`.

Run `zsh test` to check the script. It uses a temporary folder, needs no root and changes nothing on the system.

## How it works

## 1. How it works

### Why the old version was slow

`baw` has no direct-send command for a contract call. The flow is two steps by design: `contract-call preview` (the backend simulates and returns a `requestId`) and then `contract-call execute --requestId`. The old version waited for a public RPC to report a successful `eth_call` (±1 second after the opening block), then previewed, then executed. Every stage waited on the previous one: T+5–6 seconds.

### Three parallel triggers

`fire.js` does not wait on a single signal. During the 3-second **burst** window after the sale opens, three triggers may each launch a preview independently (minimum spacing `--gap` 350ms, at most `--inflight` 3 at a time):

| trigger | when | source |
|---|---|---|
| **clock** | exactly T+0 by the NTP-corrected clock | `sntp` to time.apple.com / pool.ntp.org |
| **head** | the first block with `timestamp ≥ start` is seen | WebSocket `newHeads` (QuikNode, publicnode, drpc) + HTTP polling every 150ms |
| **eth_call OK** | a simulation from the wallet succeeds on one of the 4 fastest RPCs | `eth_call` on tags `latest` and `pending`, every 100ms |

The first preview that comes back with `simulationCode 000000000` is executed immediately, **exactly once**. Other previews still in flight are ignored. Previews that fail because the backend has not seen the opening block yet (error `351805`) are cheap and harmless; the next trigger retries…

# 星瑶 (Y-code)

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

> 一个国产终端 AI 编程助手，代号「星瑶」。支持 TUI 控制台与 GUI 窗口双形态、多模型切换、子代理编排、计划执行、长期记忆、MCP 扩展与可插拔技能系统。

> **使用须知**：本项目是运行在你本地设备上的 AI 编程辅助工具，自身不提供模型服务，模型需你自行配置并直接与其通信。AI 生成内容可能不准确、需你自行审查验证；软件具备文件读写与命令执行能力，请在使用前阅读下方「免责条款」——安装向导与首次启动都会提示确认。

## ✨ 功能亮点

### 对话与界面

- **终端交互界面**：基于 `prompt_toolkit` 的 Claude Code 风格输入框，支持斜杠命令、Tab 补全、`@文件` 快速挂载、多行粘贴
- **GUI 窗口版**：基于 `pywebview` + Vue 3 + TypeScript 的图形界面，与 CLI 共享同一套核心引擎
- **GUI 拖拽附件**：拖入文件即上屏占位并自动补全真实路径，PDF 等二进制文件注入路径提示供模型用工具解析
- **文件树面板**：懒加载子目录，支持手动刷新与页签激活/窗口聚焦自动刷新，展开状态可恢复；点击图片（png/jpg/gif/webp/bmp/ico/svg）可直接弹窗预览
- **GUI 面板宽度自定义**：侧栏 / 右面板分界线可拖拽调整宽度（双击恢复默认），宽度记忆到本地重启仍生效
- **9 种终端主题**：cyan / matrix / nord / cyberpunk / dracula / lava / sunset / amber / white，`/theme` 一键切换
- **终端 Markdown 渲染**：代码块语法高亮、表格、列表等富文本展示
- **思考流显示**：实时呈现模型推理过程（`<thinking>` 标签解析 + 句子边界缓冲）

### 模型与工具

- **多模型管理**：通过 `/models` 打开全屏模型选择器，支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek / Agnes 等多种协议，由自研 HTTPX 引擎（`core/llm_native_transport.py`）统一调用
- **副模型机制**：可配置副模型承担视觉识别、记忆压缩、子代理调用等任务，主副分工
- **29 个内置工具**：文件读写、代码搜索、命令执行、网页抓取、图片下载与生图、天气查询、LSP 符号查找、计划编排、智能路由等
- **工具结果缓存**：相同搜索/读取自动走本地缓存，节省 token 与时间

### 核心内核（Harness）

- **固定主代理内核**：严格状态机（Turn 8 态 / Step 10 态），非法状态转移显式失败；内核非插件化、不可动态替换
- **SQLite Journal**：owner 租约 + 心跳防多进程冲突，事件序列单调分配，消息与事件同事务原子提交
- **崩溃恢复**：未完成回合仅标记为 `interrupted`，绝不自动重放模型请求、命令或文件写入等副作用
- **请求指纹**：对最终 Provider 请求生成不可变指纹，配合 byte-golden 回归防止缓存漂移
- **工具管线**：同签名重复调用抑制（RepeatCallGuard），相邻只读工具并发批量执行

### 高级编排

- **子代理系统**：5 种内置类型（explore / implement / test / review / general）+ 自定义子代理，支持依赖感知并行调度与嵌套（最深 3 层）
- **计划执行模式**：多步任务（拆解后子任务超过 3 条）先用 `plan_write` 建立可执行计划，按依赖图逐项派发子代理，支持暂停 / 恢复 / 重试 / 取消
- **后台任务管理**：长周期命令后台执行，`/tasks` 查看状态、`/tasks tail` 看日志、`/tasks kill` 终结
- **权限系统**：四种模式（confirm 变更前确认 / accept_edits 自动编辑 / plan 计划模式 / full 完全访问），沙盒控制工作目录访问边界

### 记忆与上下文

- **SQLite 会话记忆**：多会话切换；撤销不改写历史，聊天完整保留
- **按回合撤销**：每个回合的受控文件修改持久化快照，`/undo` 整轮预检后一键撤销；冲突零写入、崩溃可恢复，模型通过上下文得知文件结果已失效
- **长期记忆系统**：四类记忆（user / feedback / project / reference）+ 每日日志 + Dream 整理线程，支持「记住 XXX」指令
- **智能记忆压缩**：历史 token 占用达 70% 自动压缩，工具结果预截断，tiktoken 精确估算
- **会话导出**：`/share` 一键导出为 Markdown / HTML / JSON

### 扩展生态

- **技能系统（Skills）**：扫描 `SKILL.md` 并动态注入系统提示词，支持项目级与用户级
- **插件系统（Plugins）**：进程内插件扩展工具能力，零核心侵入，单插件异常不影响启动；内置混元文生图插件，支持用户级插件热加载
- **MCP 客户端**：全屏 CLI 配置器 + 10+ 预设模板（飞书 / 高德 / B 站 / SQLite / Postgres 等），AI 可自配置 MCP
- **Git Worktree**：`/worktree` 管理多分支并行工作区
- **Git 工作台**：GUI「源代码管理」页签 + CLI `/git` 命令（状态/Diff/暂存/提交/分支/同步/Stash/历史/冲突），支持外部变化自动刷新、仓库信任确认与高风险操作二次确认；AI 在对话中的 Git 操作仍走原有权限流程

HybridRobotics/supermimic.content:
# SuperMimic

[Project page](https://supermimic.github.io) | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480)

SuperMimic trains a humanoid whole-body motion tracker with one differentiable world model, built on [mjlab](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab).

## Setup

Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
```

Clone both repos as siblings:

```bash
mkdir supermimic_ws && cd supermimic_ws
git clone git@github.com:HybridRobotics/supermimic.git
git clone git@github.com:HybridRobotics/mjlab_research.git
cd supermimic
```

## Usage

Available task IDs:

- `SuperMimic-GenCoord-G1` — generalized coordinates representation
- `SuperMimic-MaxCoord-G1` — maximal coordinates representation

Train a world model and policy:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<GPU_ID> uv run src/supermimic/scripts/train.py \
  <TASK_ID> --runner.run_name <description>
```

Play back a trained model:

```bash
uv run src/supermimic/scripts/play.py \
  <TASK_ID> --wandb-path <RUN_PATH>
```

## Acknowledgements

SuperMimic contains code inspired by these projects:

- [ControlVAE](https://github.com/heyuanYao-pku/Control-VAE) (BSD-3-Clause)
- [robotic_world_model](https://github.com/leggedrobotics/robotic_world_model) (Apache-2.0)
- [DreamerV3](https://github.com/danijar/dreamerv3) (MIT)

## License

Copyright 2026 The SuperMimic Authors.

Released under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish.

Install  ·  Quickstart  ·  Documentation  ·  Website


Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants. **Elephant** holds your project context and drafts the specification. **Goldfish** reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. **You** make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing. The built-in draft and design-review workflow targets software specifications. For other documents, choose reviewers and standards with `/egm-review-loop`. Bootstrap and drift reporting apply to software codebases. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93c799a2-10a3-4266-af02-eb79dd33a9a2 ## Install Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills can read the reviewer prompts and document standards. ### ChatGPT and Codex desktop Open the [published EGM plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aeb90f47ec88191a3c107e01d3eb357) in the desktop app and install it. This listing is desktop-only. For Codex CLI, use the commands below. ### Antigravity CLI ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model ``` For the **Antigravity App** and **Antigravity for IDEs** (Visual Studio Code extension), run `/plugin` or see the [installation instructions](docs/harnesses.md#antigravity-app-and-antigravity-for-ides). ### Claude Code ```sh claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model claude plugin install egm@egm ``` ### Codex CLI ```sh codex plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model codex plugin add egm@egm ``` Start a new session after installation. For **Claude Cowork** and **ChatGPT Work**, see the [setup guide](docs/harnesses.md). ## Try a 60-second review on existing code Review an existing design document, README, or PR plan against the live code. You do not need to write a new specification. The commands below use the `/egm:` prefix for Antigravity (agy CLI) and Claude Code. In Codex, select the corresponding EGM skill from the skill picker. **Review an existing document** ```text /egm:egm-review docs/designs/webhooks.md ``` Use the path to your design doc, or to a PR plan saved as Markdown. Fresh reviewers check the design, its clarity, its fit with the code, and its implementation plan.
