routerhubSI/kimi-uncensored.content:
# Kimi Uncensored — every uncensored and abliterated Kimi model, indexed and tested **An uncensored Kimi model is a Moonshot AI Kimi variant with refusal behavior reduced — either ablated at the weight level or served as an unfiltered hosted API variant. This repo indexes all of them: the hosted Kimi K3.1 Pro Uncensored variant, abliterated open weights for K3.1 Pro and the K3 generation on Hugging Face, a red-team prompt library, and first-party test results — including the comparison nobody else has run: uncensored Kimi vs uncensored DeepSeek for cyber work.**

--- Maintained by [RouterHub](https://routerhub.si/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=kimi-uncensored) · Community-maintained. Every variant has its own page under [`models/`](models/): - [`kimi-k3.1-pro-uncensored`](models/kimi-k3.1-pro-uncensored.md) — hosted API variant - [`kimi-k3.1-pro-abliterated`](models/kimi-k3.1-pro-abliterated.md) — open-weight abliterated build - [`kimi-k3.0-abliterated`](models/kimi-k3.0-abliterated.md) — previous-generation builds that run on consumer hardware - [`kimi-k3.1-pro`](models/kimi-k3.1-pro.md) — the standard model, for comparison To add or correct an entry, open an issue — corrections and new builds are welcome. ## Why Moonshot's K3.1 Pro release is different Before publishing the K3.1 Pro weights on November 4, 2026, Moonshot removed hacking-related training data from the released checkpoint — the company reports that an uncut version solved **90.5%** of its internal exploit benchmark against **81%** for the model it shipped. The checkpoint at `moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro` is the trimmed release. So for Kimi, "uncensored" isn't a marketing adjective — Moonshot itself drew the line between the shipped behavior and the full behavior. LALUARIFTA/goodle_drive_cloud_storage_ui.content:
# Goodle Drive — Cloud Storage UI

Template dashboard penyimpanan cloud yang dibuat dengan HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript. Desain biru dengan sidebar melengkung, kartu folder, dan daftar file interaktif.

[**Buka demo**](https://laluarifta.github.io/goodle_drive_cloud_storage_ui/)

## Preview

![Preview dashboard Goodle Drive](assets/img/preview.png)

## Menjalankan

Clone repository lalu buka `index.html` di browser:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LALUARIFTA/goodle_drive_cloud_storage_ui.git
cd goodle_drive_cloud_storage_ui
```

Atau jalankan server lokal jika Python tersedia:

```bash
python -m http.server 8000
```

Buka <http://localhost:8000>. Tidak diperlukan backend untuk mencoba template.

## Struktur

```text
.
├── index.html          # Halaman utama
├── assets/
│   ├── css/            # Stylesheet frontend
│   ├── js/             # Logika interaksi dashboard
│   └── img/
│       └── preview.png # Preview untuk README
├── .gitignore
└── README.md
```

## Fitur antarmuka

- Layout responsif dengan menu sidebar untuk layar kecil.
- Pencarian file, filter folder, serta tampilan daftar dan grid.
- Navigasi My Drive, Computers, Shared With Me, Recents, Trash, Starred, dan Backups.
- Preview file, penandaan bintang, serta pengelolaan sampah dalam sesi demo.

## Kustomisasi

- Ubah struktur halaman dan identitas produk di `index.html`.
- Ubah warna dan tampilan di `assets/css/`.
- Ubah data contoh dan perilaku dashboard di `assets/js/app.js`.
- Ganti `assets/img/preview.png` untuk memperbarui screenshot README.

## Publikasi

Repository ini disajikan melalui **GitHub Pages**, dari branch `main` dan folder `/` (root). Semua path aset relatif sehingga dapat digunakan pada project site GitHub Pages maupun hosting statis lain.

Untuk repository hasil fork, aktifkan **Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → main → / (root)**, lalu perbarui URL demo pada README.

## Batasan

Ini **template frontend/demo**, bukan layanan Google Drive dan tidak berafiliasi dengan Google. Data contoh dan perubahan interaksi berada di memori browser dan kembali ke awal setelah halaman dimuat ulang. Upload, sinkronisasi, backup, berbagi, dan informasi kapasitas tidak menyediakan penyimpanan cloud nyata. Jangan gunakan untuk menyimpan data penting tanpa backend, autentikasi, dan kontrol akses yang sesuai.

Font dari Google Fonts dan foto contoh dari Unsplash memerlukan koneksi internet.

jyl681/blinkmimic2.content:
# BlinkMimic 2

**One humanoid motion-tracking policy for all 129,491 clips of BONES-SEED, trained in about 15 minutes on one RTX 4090.**

[SuperMimic](https://supermimic.github.io/) ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480),
[code](https://github.com/HybridRobotics/supermimic)) showed that one policy can track a whole motion library when it
is trained by backpropagating through a learned, differentiable world model of the robot. On BONES-SEED it reached the
tracking quality of [SONIC](https://doi.org/10.1126/scirobotics.aed4592) (trained on 128 GPUs for about a week) with
one H100 in about three hours. [InstantTrack](https://github.com/Huy-Quang-Dao/instantTrack) and
[BlinkMimic](https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic) made this learner much faster on the 40 clips of LAFAN1.

BlinkMimic 2 brings this speed to the full BONES-SEED library and studies which changes make training faster.
**One policy for all 129,491 clips trains in 15.5 minutes on one RTX 4090, with 17 failed clips** (mean of three
seeds). The main changes are exams, in which simulated robots play whole clips as the evaluation does, and a step size
planned for the short run ([how it works](#how-it-works)).

![Training time of reported BONES-SEED results, log scale](docs/media/time_comparison.png)

*Training time to each reported result on BONES-SEED (log scale). The other bars are the numbers each project
reports, with its own evaluation and hardware, so they are not on one scale; realmimic's released weights are also
scored by our evaluation. Sources: [SuperMimic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480),
[supermimic-prime](https://github.com/xkhainguyen/supermimic-prime),
[SuperMimic-Reproduced](https://github.com/CuboiLeo/SuperMimic-Reproduced),
[realmimic](https://github.com/kevinhenryzz/realmimic),
[SuperMimic-Rep](https://github.com/LaoYang1994/SuperMimic-Rep),
[supermimic_vibe](https://github.com/dhmbb2/supermimic_vibe),
[SONIC](https://doi.org/10.1126/scirobotics.aed4592) (as scored by SuperMimic).*

![Backflip, hip-hop dance, high jump, fall and get up](docs/media/hero.gif)
![Spinning turns, crawl, sitting cross-legged, push-ups](docs/media/more.gif)

*One trained policy in the simulator, each clip played from its first frame. Solid: robot; translucent blue: the
reference motion. Every clip shown was tracked to its end in the evaluation on all clips and in at least 137 repeated
runs.*

## Results

| | training | clips tracked to the end | failed clips | tracking score |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **BlinkMimic 2** (mean of 3 seeds) | **15.5 min**, one RTX 4090 | **99.987%** | **17** of 129,491 | **0.946** |
| [realmimic](https://github.com/kevinhenryzz/realmimic) released weights, for scale | about 10.5 h, one RTX 4090 | 99.988% | 16 of 129,491 | 0.950 |

Every clip is played once from its first frame in the simulator, without randomization, and both rows are scored by
the same evaluation.

- **Failed clip**: the robot falls or drifts away from the reference before the clip ends …

# Toyxyz Blender Retargeter

Transfer natural-looking humanoid motion between rigs with different body proportions in Blender 5.0 or later. Proportion-aware root travel, adjustable limb reach, and foot contact help adapt stride and foot placement to the target rig while preserving the source motion. Preview the result live and bake it to a Blender Action.

[Download the latest release](https://github.com/toyxyz/toyxyz-blender-retargeter/releases/latest) · [Read the user guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md)

## Demo

Both videos use the same source motion and the same three target rigs, with short, standard, and long legs.

### Toyxyz Blender Retargeter

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/784f2eaa-0a1a-4120-929a-e4eb2ae73ccd

### FK-only comparison

The target rigs use direct FK rotation copying without the add-on.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/92e0edd6-31b7-4b0c-9bfd-5ca1aa047eb9

## Add-on interface

![Retarget sidebar with three connected actors and controls for baking, solver options, reference poses, and bone mapping](docs/images/addon-interface.png)

## Quick start

1. Download the add-on ZIP and install it from **Preferences → Get Extensions → Install from Disk**.
2. Open the **Retarget** tab in the 3D Viewport sidebar. Choose the **Source** and **Target** armatures.
3. Click **Bone Mapping → Build Bones List**, review the assignments, and click **Connect**.
4. Preview the motion and click **Bake to Action** when you are ready to edit the result.

## Features

- Live retargeting for multiple rig pairs, with per-actor settings
- Automatic bone matching, manual mapping, and reusable JSON presets
- Editable reference poses, limb reach, root travel, and foot contact
- Single-actor and batch baking to Blender Actions

Hand contact control is currently limited, including the ability to keep the palms planted during weight-bearing motions.

## Build from source

Run `blender --command extension build --source-dir .` from the repository root.

# Flash ALOHA: Learning Fast and Precise Manipulation

Project website: johnyao93.github.io/flash-aloha

Data collection, training and deployment for bimanual and single-arm manipulation
with ARX arms (L5 and Trossen_L5): camera servers, hand-guided recording, ACT
and Flow policy training, direct and remote inference, and visualization.

Two policies are included: decoder-only ACT (the default) and Flow, which uses the
LeRobot U-Net/visual backbone. Both support training-time RTC prefix conditioning
and optional image/proprioceptive masking. The remote client can also execute an
OpenPI server's policy (for example Pi0.5); see `docs/image_preprocessing.md`.

## Quick start

The steps below are each described in their own section. Commands that move a robot
are marked operator-run: read the section before running them.

```bash
# 1. Install and run the offline tests (no robot needed)
uv sync --extra dev && source .venv/bin/activate && source scripts/setup/paths.sh
python -m pytest

# 2. Connect an arm, then tune its gravity and friction compensation
uv run scripts/tune.py gravity L5 can0              # MODEL INTERFACE
uv run scripts/tune.py friction L5 can0

# 3. Practice: move the arm by hand, then record a motion and replay it (no cameras, nothing saved)
uv run scripts/practice.py --arm right
uv run src/recording/replay_practice.py --arms right

# 4. Save a start pose and record demonstrations
uv run scripts/setup/set_up_recording.py --task_name single_arm
python scripts/run.py collect single_arm

# 5. Train, then run the policy
python scripts/run.py train single_arm_act
python scripts/run.py infer single_arm_act
```

`single_arm` (one ARX arm, two cameras) and `bimanual` (two ARX arms, three cameras)
are the example tasks in `src/config/tasks/`; copy one to describe your own setup.

## Setup

Run commands from the repository root. Once per terminal:

```bash
uv sync --extra dev
source .venv/bin/activate
source scripts/setup/paths.sh
python -m pytest                    # offline: synthetic observations, simulated hardware
```

The tests never start a camera or a robot controller. `.python-version` selects
Python 3.10.

Build the ARX SDK's Python extension on the robot computer following
[src/hardware/arx5-sdk/README.md](src/hardware/arx5-sdk/README.md) (its Conda environment
supplies the native dependencies). `paths.sh` expects that environment at
`$HOME/miniconda3/envs/arx-py310`; set `ARX_CONDA_PREFIX` if yours is elsewhere, and
`OROCOS_KDL_PYTHON` if you built PyKDL from source.

The files under `calibration/` were measured on one physical setup and are examples
only: recalibrate for your own arms and cameras before use
([calibration/README.md](calibration/README.md)).

Datasets, checkpoints and logs default to `data/`, `ckpts/` and `logs/` in the
repository root and are not part of the repository. To keep them elsewhere, for
example on a larger disk, set any of:

```bash

export FLASH_ALOHA_CKPT_DI…

Shape

Shape decodes captured request headers into named signal fields. You can inspect those fields, change supported values, and encode the full decoded payload back into headers while retaining its other signals and report channels. For a new capture, trace its VM seed into readable JavaScript and use that program with the matching session to compile a decode artifact. Save the artifact to decode later requests from that build and session without repeating the source analysis. You can also deobfuscate the kernel and name recovered functions to investigate how signals are collected. Use the CLI for one-off work with files, or load an artifact once in the SDK for repeated calls from your application. Both use the same engine: | | Use it to | Start here | | --- | --- | --- | | **[Shape CLI](#shape-cli)** | Investigate a capture from the terminal: deobfuscate, trace, name functions, extract signal layouts, decode and encode | `cargo build --release --locked --bin shape` | | **[SDK](#sdk)** | Do the same from your application in Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust or C | `scripts/build-sdk.sh` | Before running any `shape` command, follow the [CLI build and PATH setup](#build-once) from the repository root. The table below shows where each operation is available. A decode artifact saved by the CLI loads in every SDK, so you can prepare a capture in the terminal and reuse the result in your application. | Task | CLI | SDK command | | --- | --- | --- | | Deobfuscate a kernel | `shape deob` | `deob` | | Compile a kernel artifact | `shape report` | `report` | | Inspect VM properties and operations | `shape kernel show`, `shape ops list`, `shape ops show` | `kernel.show`, `ops.list`, `ops.show` | | Recover the linked program | `shape trace program` | `trace.program` | | Walk or clean one thread | `shape trace thread`, `shape trace cleanup-thread` | `trace.thread`, `cleanup.thread` | | Name functions and collectors | `shape naming threads`, `collectors`, `plan`, `inventory` | `naming.*` | | Compare captures | `shape trace corpus`, `shape naming corpus` | | | Extract the signal schema | `shape signals` | `signals.schema` | | Pin a session layout | `shape pin` | `pin` | | Compile a decode artifact | `shape decode --save-artifact` | `artifact.compile` | | Decode headers into named fields | `shape decode --artifact` | Generator `decode`, `explain` | | Encode edited fields back into headers | — (use the SDK; the CLI encodes framed payloads, not named fields) | Generator `encode` | | Look up what a signal means | `shape show signals` | | | Report and payload framing | `shape payload`, `shape headers`, `shape pack`, `shape unpack` | | **Contents:** [Scope and limitations](#scope-and-limitations) · [Choose a path](#choose-a-path) · [How it fits together](#how-it-fits-together) · [Inputs](#inputs) · [Shape CLI](#shape-cli) · [SDK](#sdk) · [Decoded signals and editing](sdk/signals.md) · [SDK performance](#performance-in-the-sdk) · [T…

# DaMail **All your mailboxes on your own server, ready for AI agents.** DaMail is a self-hosted mail hub. It syncs every mailbox you own into one place and adds AI triage and automation.
AI agents get scoped, auditable access to it through MCP and a REST API. The name sounds like dame (だめ), Japanese for “nope”: no agent sends a single email without your OK. [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/gopkg-dev/damail?sort=semver&color=1677ff)](https://github.com/gopkg-dev/damail/releases) [![Build](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/gopkg-dev/damail/release.yml?label=build)](https://github.com/gopkg-dev/damail/actions/workflows/release.yml) [![Docker image](https://img.shields.io/badge/ghcr.io-gopkg--dev%2Fdamail-2496ED?logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/gopkg-dev/damail/pkgs/container/damail) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/gopkg-dev/damail?color=green)](LICENSE) [Website](https://damail.app/) · [Documentation](https://damail.app/docs/) · [Changelog](https://github.com/gopkg-dev/damail/releases) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## Why DaMail - **One inbox for every account.** DaMail works with Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, QQ Mail, NetEase 163, Tencent and Alibaba business mail, and any IMAP server. Mail syncs in real time and is threaded and searchable. # ScanDot

[![CI](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

ScanDot is an experimental Android app for capturing and viewing 3D point clouds on a supported phone. It combines ARCore camera tracking and depth estimates, saves scans locally, and provides an interactive viewer.

The repository also contains a separate video photogrammetry pipeline that runs on a workstation using FFmpeg and COLMAP. **The Android app does not reconstruct ordinary video with photogrammetry on the phone.**

## Current status

- Capture, save and reopen point clouds on devices that support ARCore Depth.
- Rotate, pan and zoom scans in the viewer. An optional full-depth mode interpolates missing depth and can distort surfaces.
- Prepare video frames and run a sparse or dense COLMAP reconstruction on a workstation.

This is an early prototype. Results can contain gaps, drift and noise; they are not textured meshes or validated measurements. Reflective, transparent and textureless subjects are difficult. Capture quality and device compatibility need further testing.

## Try the preview

Download the [preview APK](https://github.com/faizfahmi77/ScanDot/releases/tag/v0.3.0-preview.1). The release notes describe compatibility and signing limitations.

## Build the Android app

You need JDK 17, Android SDK 36, and an Android device with ARCore Depth support. Camera permission is required; Google Play Services for AR may require installation or an update.

```sh
cd android-app
./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug testDebugUnitTest
```

On Windows, use `gradlew.bat` in place of `./gradlew`. The debug APK is written to `android-app/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Install it as an update to preserve existing app data.

In the app, name the scan, tap **Start scan**, and move slowly around the subject in good light. Save it, then open it from **Results**. Scans are stored in the app's private storage; uninstalling the app removes them.

## Workstation video pipeline

The benchmark requires Python 3.12 or newer, FFmpeg, FFprobe and a compatible COLMAP installation. Dense reconstruction requires a compatible COLMAP configuration. From the repository root:

```sh
python -m processing.benchmark prepare "path/to/input.mp4" --output "path/to/new-run" --fps 5
python -m processing.benchmark reconstruct "path/to/new-run" --colmap "path/to/colmap" --dense
```

The output directory must not already exist. Omit `--dense` for a sparse-only run. See the subcommand `--help` output for options. A successful run does not establish complete or accurate geometry.

The Python tests use the standard library:

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

## Project structure

```text
android-app/  Android capture, local storage and point-cloud viewer
processing/   Video preparation and COLMAP orchestration
tests/        Python tests with synthetic fixtures
tools/        Workstation utilities…

# 屏幕教学助手 · guide-tutor

在 Windows 桌面上"手把手"教用户操作：一个置顶悬浮球负责读屏，一层全屏透明标注层画箭头/圆圈/矩形，一块可调透明度的半透明面板写当前该做什么，外加一个本地 Markdown 知识库存教学步骤。

由两部分组成：

- **DSH Host 插件**（`index.js`）：注册 `guide_*` 工具、管理知识库、拉起并守护悬浮层进程、提供本机 HTTP / SSE 实时接口。
- **原生 WPF 悬浮层**（`native/overlay.ps1`）：悬浮球、标注层、面板三扇窗口，全程置顶、标注层鼠标穿透。

## 现在能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 读屏 | 点球（或面板上的「读屏」）→ 悬浮层自动隐藏 0.2 秒截图 → 宿主把截图作为一条消息发给当前对话 → 模型读图后标注 |
| 屏幕标注 | `rect` / `circle` / `arrow` / `text` / `spotlight`，可带小标签，坐标与截图 1:1 |
| 半透明面板 | 标题、正文（建议 ≤30 字，可拖选复制，右上 `⧉` 一键复制整块）、步骤列表（当前步高亮）、35–100% 透明度滑块、可折叠成球；输入框支持 `Ctrl+V` 与右键粘贴 |
| 时钟 | 球下面常驻 `HH:mm`，面板标题栏常驻 `HH:mm:ss`；每 120ms 的 tick 只在秒数变化时重画，不额外占 CPU |
| 大小可调 | 面板底部「大小」滑块拖动即可，70%–180% 连续可调（松手 0.4 秒后落盘）；球上 `Ctrl+滚轮` 一档 5%。只缩放上半部分（标题/正文/步骤/下一步），底部操作条保持原大——否则滑块会跟着自己变长，一拖就冲到顶。值存进 `state.json` 的 `panel.uiScale`，重启后还在 |
| 知识库 | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\guide-tutor\kb\*.md` 与 `*.docx`，模型可读写，下次直接复用步骤 |
| Word 文档 | `guide_kb` 存 `.docx` 时用 Markdown 生成排版好的 Word（标题/列表/表格）；也能导入、读取已有 `.docx` |
| 语音播报 | 回复用本机 SAPI 中文语音念出来，屏幕出现逐字渐显的字幕，字幕与语音按词同步；**回复会被拆成一句一句念**，句间停顿，像人在说话，而不是压成一句概括 |
| 触发时机 | 以 DSH 的持久 `turn/end` 事件为准：面板发消息、DSH 输入框打字、语音输入都会触发朗读，不再依赖某条输入路径 |
| 对话记录 | 面板标题栏的「记录」：列出插件端最近的对话流水（时间、谁说的、从哪说、内容），数据存在 `chatlog.json`，只留最近 120 条，纯本机 |
| 时间检测 | 每 60 秒一次心跳（`tickIntervalSec` 可改）：记下当前时间、写 `ticks.jsonl`、广播 SSE `tick` 事件，并挨个调用 `registerTickHandler` 订阅者。现在给计划/待办提供时间基准，也是以后子代理「到点读屏上报」的接入点 |
| 字幕定位 | 字幕出现在最近一次标注旁边（标注下方，放不下就放上方）；没有标注时在屏幕底部居中 |
| 语音 | 面板「说」按钮或 `Ctrl+Alt+V`：本地离线 sherpa-onnx paraformer 识别中文（不联网、不要 key）→ 作为一条【语音】消息发给模型 → 模型照常看屏/标注 |
| 面板对话 | 面板底部输入框写目标/问题，回车发送：模型先和你确认目标、列计划，你说「开始」它才开始标注 |
| 收尾 | 面板「✓」或 `guide_finish`：模型先截屏核验，再清空标注、面板折叠回球，任务标记完成 |
| 实时接口 | 本机 HTTP + SSE + 浏览器状态页，外部脚本也能驱动标注与读屏 |
| 托盘图标 | 任务栏托盘一个「引」图标：左键打开面板，右键菜单可读屏一次 / 切换常听 / 隐藏悬浮层 / 退出 |
| 下一步按钮 | 面板底部「下一步 ›」：表示这步做完了，宿主自动截屏并把下一步交给模型（也可 `POST /next`） |
| 常听 | 面板「常听」勾选框或托盘菜单：说完一句自动继续听；连续 5 次没听清会自动关闭并提示 |
| 语音音色 | 默认 **Edge 晓晓**（`zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural`，神经网络音色，需联网）；断网或合成失败自动回落到系统 SAPI「惠惠」。换音色：`index.js` 的 `config.edgeVoice`（可选 `zh-CN-YunxiNeural`、`zh-CN-YunyangNeural`、`zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural`、`zh-CN-liaoning-XiaobeiNeural` 等 14 个中文音色）；想完全离线用 `config.ttsEngine: 'sapi'` |
| 桌面清单 | 目标排成当天的**真实时间轴**，贴右缘、满屏高：每条一个块，**块高由内容决定**（标题自动换行，长课也一样完整显示），只有空档 ≥25 分钟才画一条 `06:00–08:30` 这样的细分隔线，一天排到 22:30；点 ☐ 打勾/取消、每条右侧 **✎ 改**（弹预填窗口）/ **✕ 删**、拖标题栏、点 ✕ 收起、点 ⚙ 开设置（清单透明度/宽度、悬浮球透明度、面板透明度/大小、提醒语气）、点标题栏 **＋** 自己加一条任务（填开始/结束/地点/做什么，`HH:mm`，手填的时间原样落盘，不往番茄钟上拗）；**空档行右侧还有一个淡淡的 ＋**，点了直接用那一段的开始时间预填（结束 +25 分钟），不用手改时间。数据在 `plan.json`，卡片读 `state.plan` + `state.card`，是无边框 + 强半透明的「伪融入」，不是真嵌壁纸层 |
| 顶部任务条 | 屏幕顶端一行，显示**当前时段**该做的事，带**秒级**倒计时（`15:26–15:51　秒级倒计时测试　@ 宿舍　·　剩 24:03`，每秒跳）；当前没有条目时退而显示 30 分钟内即将开始的一条（前缀「接着」，显示「12:30 后」），都没有就自动隐藏。拖动可移动；右端「−/＋」或直接滚轮调大小（0.7–2.0，0.1 一档）；位置与大小存 `state.json` 的 `topbar`，重启还在 |

已经装在本机的 desktop profile 里（`link:` 到本目录）。重装 / 更新：

豆包工作 · 账号管家

只做豆包工作：多账号、每日签到、JSON 备份和 OpenAI 兼容接口。

Windows / macOS / Linux · Node.js 22+ · 零 npm 运行依赖

快速开始 · 接入客户端 · 账号迁移 · 429 排查

> 独立第三方项目，非豆包官方产品。原生版在同一个 Node 进程中运行管理面板与模型 API，无 Agent2API、Magpie、提供商插件或 npm 运行依赖。 ## 界面预览 | 工作台 | 接口节点 | | --- | --- | | | | 以上为既有布局展示，不代表当前账号的模型与额度。[签到计划](docs/screenshots/checkin.png) · [深色工作台](docs/screenshots/overview-dark-v02.jpg) · [手机工作台](docs/screenshots/overview-mobile-v02.jpg)。 ## 功能 - **多账号浏览器登录**：每次在独立 Chrome / Edge 临时会话登录，同一身份更新原账号；日常浏览器不受影响。 - **账号工作台**：搜索、备注、批量启停、额度查询和验证状态。账号与模型 Key 加密保存在本机。 - **自动签到**：北京时间计划，按账号选择；同日有提交记录后只回查，不重复领取。 - **两类 JSON**：账号备份用于登录迁移；节点 JSON 用于保存客户端的 Base URL、模型及可选 Key，不参与转发选路。 - **自建 API Key**：随机生成或指定内容，支持命名、复制、启停；模型 Key 与管理接口分离。 - **文本 API**：`/v1/models` 与 `/v1/chat/completions`，支持流式和非流式文本。不承诺原生工具调用、图片及工作流兼容。 ## 快速开始 需要 **Node.js 22 或更高版本**。使用浏览器登录时，还需要 Chrome 或 Edge；带图形桌面的 Linux 也可使用 Chromium。安装 Git 后，执行： ```sh git clone https://github.com/245678000000/doubao-work-gateway.git cd doubao-work-gateway npm start ``` 无需执行 `npm install`。也可从 GitHub 下载源码 ZIP，解压后在项目目录执行 `npm start`。 1. 打开 [本机面板](http://127.0.0.1:43862)，在工作台点击「添加账号」，在弹出的独立浏览器窗口登录豆包。 2. 登录后在工作台核对账号状态；添加下一个账号时会开启新的临时会话。 3. 如需每日签到，在「自动签到」中设置北京时间、勾选账号，并保存计划。执行时网关需保持运行。 | 系统 | 启动 | 停止 | | --- | --- | --- | | Windows | `start.cmd` 或 `npm start` | `stop.cmd` 或 `npm stop` | | macOS | `./start.command` 或 `npm start` | `./stop.command` 或 `npm stop` | | Linux | `./start.sh` 或 `npm start` | `./stop.sh` 或 `npm stop` | 也可在启动终端按 Ctrl+C 停止，账号资料会保留。`npm run status` 查看运行状态；`npm run doctor` 检查 Node、运行目录及浏览器。无图形桌面的服务器可用账号 JSON 迁移，见[跨平台说明](docs/platforms.md)。 ## 接入客户端 登录并核验账号后，打开面板的「接口接入」，按下表填写 OpenAI 兼容客户端： | 客户端字段 | 填写内容 | | --- | --- | | Base URL | `http://127.0.0.1:43861/v1`（默认本机模型端口） | | API Key | 面板里的默认 Key，或专为该客户端创建的 Key | | 模型 ID | 从「接口接入」的实际模型列表复制 | `43862` 是管理端口，`43861` 是模型端口，别把面板地址填进客户端。模型列表接口为 `GET /v1/models`，文本请求使用 `POST /v1/chat/completions`。面板也提供可复制的调用示例。 ## 原账号迁移 优先在工作台「导入 JSON」：支持原生备份与旧版 v2 账号 JSON。先预览、确认导入，再逐个选择「核验备份」。导入的名字或标识不代替官方身份核验。重复账号默认跳过，已核验的会话不会被未核验文件替换。 没有 JSON、但有旧版私有状态目录时，先确认旧进程已停止，再运行 `node launcher.mjs migrate-legacy`。若原目录与当前状态目录不同，将原状态目录作为命令的最后一个参数。迁移只读旧库、只写原生加密库，重复执行跳过已导入条目。旧文件保留。 原生运行目录优先使用 `DW_RUNTIME_ROOT`，其次为项目中的私有 `.runtime-root`，默认 `.local/`。可用 `DW_STATE_DIR` 单独指定状态目录。 ## 遇到 429 / 710022004 这表示豆包上游要求人工验证，与普通限流和额度耗尽分开显示。网关暂停实际触发的账号，保留状态和请求编号；不会把本次请求自动转给其他账号，也不会在后台换模型重试。 1. 使用同一个账号打开[豆包官网](https://www.doubao.com/chat/)，发一条普通消息并完成页面提示的验证。 2. 回到工作台，点击「已完成验证」，再点击「复测一次」。只有收到完整的文本响应才恢复该账号参与转发。 3. 如果原出口仍要求验证…

reyohoho/ReTwitch-src.content:
# ReTwitch

An unofficial modification of the Twitch Android app, built with
[Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch.

This repository holds the source of the mod and the "kitchen" that builds it from
the original Twitch bundle. The Twitch app itself is not here: bring your own.

[Русский - ниже](#русский)

![What the mod does](docs/features.png)

## What you need

- Linux or macOS, Python 3.10+, JDK 17+ (`java`, `javac`, `jar`, `keytool`)
- Android SDK with build-tools (`d8`, `apksigner`) and a platform (`android.jar`);
  set `ANDROID_HOME`
- The Twitch **31.9.0** bundle (versionCode 3109006) as a split `.apks` file

Check that the bundle is the original one before building:

```bash
unzip -p Twitch+31.9.0.apks base.apk > /tmp/base.apk
apksigner verify --print-certs /tmp/base.apk
```

The signer's SHA-256 digest must be
`1338f9b049893cc70b78432a177582f90bd4bc6296ea4ed35bcc7df59687ac53`.

## Build

```bash
cd kitchen
./rebuild.sh /path/to/Twitch+31.9.0.apks
```

The first run downloads the pinned tools and libraries into `kitchen/bin/` and
`kitchen/libs/` (`python3 -m kitchen.deps`, every file is checked by SHA-256).
The result is `kitchen/work/ReTwitch_<version>.apk`.

The first build also creates your signing key, `kitchen/keystore/retwitch-morphe.keystore`.
Keep it: later builds must be signed with the same key to install as updates. Your
build is signed with a different key than the official one, so uninstall the
official ReTwitch before installing it.

Crash reports are off in this source: `CrashReporter.API_KEY` is empty. Put your own
AppMetrica key there to get them.

## Bugs and ideas

[Open an issue](https://github.com/reyohoho/ReTwitch-src/issues/new/choose): the bug form says which of the mod's
logs to turn on, where the file lands and how to attach a screen recording and your settings.

## Support the project

- [Boosty](https://boosty.to/sentryward/)
- [ext.rte.net.ru](https://ext.rte.net.ru/): a subscription on the ReYohoho site
- USDT (TRC20): `TW7mGaKbgUNXsmF9CkggK2vrvKxW7uxFmG`
- USDT (BEP20): `0xa994fc48Df0D519083cb4aaCD3aF440571B5658b`

## Layout

| Path | What |
|------|------|
| `kitchen/mod/src` | The mod's Java code, compiled into an extra dex |
| `kitchen/mod/test` | JVM self-checks for the pure logic |
| `kitchen/retwitch-patches` | Bytecode and resource patches (Kotlin, morphe-patcher) |
| `kitchen/kitchen` | Build helpers: bundle merge, extension dex, pinned downloads |
| `kitchen/i18n` | Translations; the key is the English text |

## License

GPL-3.0-or-later, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). [NOTICE](NOTICE) lists the code this
project builds on and the additional terms under GPLv3 section 7: modified
versions must be marked as such and must not be distributed under the names
"ReTwitch" or "ReYohoho".

---

[Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp). Twitch к нему отношения не имеет.

oil-oil/agy-fast-io.content:
fast-io 是一个 Antigravity 插件，里面只有一份规则（[`plugin/rules/AGENTS.md`](plugin/rules/AGENTS.md)），没有工具、Hook，也没有 MCP。它改的是 Agent 干活的习惯：怎么找代码、一次读多少、命令怎么写、回答写多长。同样的任务，模型回合更少，桌面版要等的云端审查也更少。 > 这是个人做的非官方插件，和 Google 没有关系。 ## 效果 我在一个有 2,000 多个 Swift 文件的真实项目上做了对照测试：同一时段、同一个模型，一组不加规则，一组加规则，每个任务跑 3 到 6 次，再按事先定好的标准答案自动评分。 - 找引用、读懂一段机制、跨模块追踪调用链、多文件改名，这 4 类任务都变快了，幅度在四分之一到一半之间，合计快了将近一半。 - 模型回合大约少了一半。 - 答案质量没有下降，加规则前后都是满分。 - 装到桌面版之后，检索命令大多不再触发云端审查。我自己用了几个小时，要送审的工具调用从四成多降到了两成多。 大模型每次的表现波动很大，同一个任务最快和最慢能差一倍，所以这些数字只能当量级看。 ## Antigravity 慢在哪 Antigravity 慢，主要不是读文件本身慢。我翻了自己几个星期的会话记录和桌面版日志，时间大多花在下面几处。

**模型回合太多。** 模型每想一轮要 10 到 20 秒，工具执行本身只占很小一部分，所以多走一轮就多等一轮。可 Agent 习惯读一个文件、想一下、再读下一个；我的记录里，读文件的回合有将近一半只读了一个文件。它还常常只读几十行，不够再回头补，一个任务就这样拖出十几轮。 **没有原生的搜索工具。** 在桌面版 2.0 里，Agent 能用来看代码的只有 `read_file` 和 `run_command`。要搜代码只能跑 `rg`、`find` 这样的命令，而这些命令正好会撞上下一条。 **桌面版的云端审查。** 每个工具调用执行之前，桌面版会先拿内置的白名单检查一遍。`grep`、`cat`、`ls`、`git log` 这类只读命令直接放行；名单外的命令（包括 `rg`、`find`，以及任何带 `&&`、`;`、重定向的命令）和每一次改文件，都要先送云端小模型审查，每次 2 到 3 秒，可疑或超时还会再审一次。审查和执行是排队进行的，审完才能执行。装插件之前，我的会话里大约 45% 的工具调用都要送审。我没找到能关掉这层审查的设置；`agy` 命令行版本没有这层审查。 **最后的回答太长。** 测试里问“这段机制是怎么工作的”这类问题时，Agent 最后一轮写了一两万字，光这一轮就要一两分钟，占了整个任务时间的六七成。 另外两点也值得知道： - 常被提到的 `read_file` 800 行上限，其实影响不大。我的记录里，被截断的读取只占 2% 左右。 - 模型也有影响。我的记录里，同样的上下文长度下，Gemini 4 Carbon (High) 每轮比 Argon (High) 慢三成左右。 ## fast-io 做了什么

图里的 4 个编号，对应规则里的 4 件事： 1. **先定位，再一轮读完。** 先用一条 `grep -rn` 拿到所有命中的文件和行号，再在同一轮里并行读要看的位置。一次读够 150 到 200 行，300 行以内的文件整份读，不一段一段往回补。 2. **检索只用白名单里的命令。** 用 `grep`、`git ls-files`、`ls` 这些免审命令找代码，不写 `rg`、`find`、`cd … &&`；glob 加引号，git 参数用长写法。 3. **反正要审的命令，合成一次跑。** `python3`、`npm`、构建、测试这类命令每次都要审。互不依赖的几步用 `&&` 串成一次，只审一次，也少等一轮。 4. **回答先给结论。** 不贴大段代码，不复述读到的内容，一般控制在 1,500 字以内。想要详细说明时，直接跟它说“详细讲”。 另外还有几条小规则：小改动用 `edit_file`，同一文件里相邻的几处合成一次改；小任务不写计划文档。完整规则不到 70 行，可以直接看 [`AGENTS.md`](plugin/rules/AGENTS.md)。 ## 安装 需要 Antigravity 桌面版或 `agy` 命令行。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/oil-oil/agy-fast-io.git ``` ```bash agy plugin install agy-fast-io/plugin ``` 桌面版不用重启，新开的会话就会用上。没有 `agy` 命令行的话，也可以把 `plugin` 目录直接复制过去： ```bash cp -R agy-fast-io/plugin ~/.gemini/config/plugins/fast-io ``` 装好后新开一个会话，让它找一段代码。如果它先跑一条 `grep -rn`，再在同一轮里读好几个文件，就说明规则生效了。桌面版的 Plugins 面板里也能看到 Fast IO；没出现的话，重启一次 Antigravity。 想暂时关掉或重新打开： ```bash agy plugin disable fast-io ``` ```bash agy plugin enable fast-io ``` ## 局限 - **规则不是强制的。** 模型大多数时候会照做，偶尔不会，比如把几条 `git` 查看命令用 `&&` 串起来，反而触发了审查。 - **改文件的审查省不掉。** 桌面版每次 `e…

# T vendo **让 Agent 方便地发现和调用工具的自托管平台**
统一接入 HTTP 与 MCP 工具，人民币计价、按次计费，使用同一个余额与预算。 [![CI](https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dyunwei/tvendo)](https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/releases) [![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/dyunwei/tvendo)](https://hub.docker.com/r/dyunwei/tvendo) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@dyunwei/tvendo)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dyunwei/tvendo) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-LGPL--3.0-blue)](LICENSE) ![Tvendo 控制台](docs/screenshots/console.png)
## 为什么选择 Tvendo - **面向 Agent**：用中文查找工具，查看参数和价格，通过 CLI 或 API 调用。 - **统一接入**：管理员配置 HTTP / JSON 或远程 MCP 上游，用户使用平台密钥。 - **费用可控**：人民币固定单次售价、统一余额、预算限制和调用记录。 ## 功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 工具目录 | 工具文本搜索、参数 Schema、输入示例与价格 | | Agent 接入 | 中文 Skill、Go CLI、REST API | | 上游管理 | HTTP 配置、MCP 工具同步、批量上下架与定价 | | 余额与预算 | 余额预留、成功结算、失败退款、单次与每日预算 | | 用户控制台 | 平台 API Key、用量、钱包与预算设置 | | 部署 | Docker Compose，PostgreSQL 与 Redis | ## 快速开始 需要 Docker Engine 和 Compose 插件。下载配置并编辑 `.env`： ```sh mkdir tvendo && cd tvendo curl -fsSLO https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/releases/latest/download/compose.yaml curl -fsSL https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/releases/latest/download/env.example -o .env ``` 设置数据库密码、管理员邮箱和密码、`ENCRYPTION_KEY`（用 `openssl rand -hex 32` 生成）与 `PUBLIC_URL`。下载的配置模板已将 `TVENDO_VERSION` 固定为该 Release 的版本，然后启动： ```sh docker compose pull docker compose up -d ``` 打开 `http://localhost:8080`，用配置的管理员账户登录。添加上游 → 核对参数和价格 → 开放工具 → 给用户充值 → 用户创建平台 API Key。 镜像、npm 包和部署附件在 Release 工作流成功后可用。提前试用可从源码运行 `make source-up`。HTTPS、完整配置、镜像源、升级及备份见 [部署说明](docs/deployment.md)。 ## 接入 Agent 把下面这句话发给 Agent： ```text 请读取 https://<你的服务地址>/SKILL.md，帮我配置 Tvendo 工具接入。 ``` 也可直接安装 CLI，在本机配置 `TVENDO_SERVER` 和 `TVENDO_API_KEY` 后使用： ```sh npm install -g @dyunwei/tvendo tvendo doctor --json tvendo tools search '网页搜索' --json ``` 无需全局安装时用 `npx --yes @dyunwei/tvendo --help`。完整配置、二进制安装及调用流程见 [Agent 接入](docs/agent-access.md)。 ## 项目状态 当前采用人工充值，支持同步 HTTP / JSON 和远程 MCP 工具调用。工具与供应商凭据由部署管理员配置，不附带现成的付费服务。已知限制与验证范围见 [兼容性](docs/compatibility.md)。 ## 文档与贡献 [文档索引](docs/README.md) · [部署](docs/deployment.md) · [Agent 接入](docs/agent-access.md) · [上游管理](docs/upstreams.md) · [API](docs/api.md) · [开发](docs/development.md) · [维护与发布](docs/maintaining.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/dyunwei/tvendo/issues) 和 Pull Requests 参与改进。 ## 许可证 Copyright © 2026 dyunwei。 本项目采用 [GNU LGPL v3](LICENSE)（`LGPL-3.0-only`），附带其引用的 [GNU GPL v3 条款](COPYING.GPL-3)。

# InstantAMP: Train AMP in 30 minutes on 1 RTX 5090

InstantAMP trains a Unitree G1 velocity-tracking policy with an **adversarial motion prior (AMP)** in about 30 minutes on a single
RTX 5090. The policy walks, runs, side-steps and turns like the human clips it learns from, and it gets back up after a fall.

The policy is not trained with model-free RL alone. Like [SuperMimic](https://github.com/HybridRobotics/supermimic), InstantAMP fits a
**differentiable world model** of the robot from simulator transitions. The policy is then optimized with **analytic gradients through
short imagined rollouts** (backpropagation through time). The style rewards of the two motion priors are differentiable in the
imagined states too, so the policy follows their gradient through the world model like any other reward term.

The whole training loop is compiled with JAX, including the [MuJoCo Warp](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_warp) simulator,
and runs on one GPU. The code builds on [XSoma](https://github.com/nico-bohlinger/xsoma).

## Contents

- [What is trained](#what-is-trained)
- [Results](#results)
- [Setup](#setup)
- [Motion data](#motion-data)
- [Training](#training)
- [Flags](#flags)
- [Evaluation and rendering](#evaluation-and-rendering)
- [Repository layout](#repository-layout)
- [Acknowledgements and citation](#acknowledgements-and-citation)
- [License](#license)

## What is trained

| Part | What it is |
|---|---|
| Robot | Unitree G1, 29 joints. mjlab's MJCF with full collision (self-collisions included) and the Unitree actuator model (torque-speed curve and friction), 200 Hz physics, 50 Hz policy. |
| Task | Follow velocity commands on flat ground: vx ∈ [−1.5, 3.0] m/s, vy ∈ [−1, 1] m/s, wz ∈ [−π/2, π/2] rad/s. 25 % of the envs use heading control and 5 % stand still. Commands are redrawn every 3 to 8 s. |
| Observation | 4 frames of history (384 values): pelvis angular velocity, gravity, command, joint positions and velocities, last action. Noise is added, and the policy normalizes the observation with running statistics. |
| Rewards | Velocity tracking on the pelvis, regularizers (joint acceleration, joint limits, action rate, foot slip, self-collision, wrist pose), a termination penalty, and a rise penalty while the robot is down. |
| Falls and get-up | An upright robot is terminated as soon as its pelvis, hips, shoulders, torso or hands touch the floor. 20 % of the resets start on the floor in a frame of a LAFAN1 get-up clip, and the robot has 5 s to stand up. |
| Robustness | Pushes every 5 to 10 s, shoves at reset, randomized foot friction, encoder bias and torso CoM. |
| Motion priors | Two WGAN-GP discriminators over 10-frame windows: one for walking and running (used while the robot is up) and one for getting up (used while it is down). |
| Learner | World model (MLP 3×512, 8-step open-loop loss), BPTT over a 48-step horizon (about 1 s), a critic that bootstraps the return at the horizon, an ODE actor, and a hybrid PPO term on 1…

# homelab-diagram

The script behind the network diagram of my homelab that I posted on r/homelab. It turns a YAML file describing the lab into a big SVG/PNG diagram in the style of the diagrams you see on r/homelab.

![Example output](docs/example.png)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This is not a general tool.** The *content* comes from `inventory.yaml`, but the *layout* (where every box, port and cable goes) is hand-placed in `build.py` for exactly my network. If you want to use it for yours, expect to move coordinates around in the code. Think of it as a starting point, not a finished product.

> [!NOTE]
> **The code was written by AI.** I built this together with Claude (Anthropic) in Claude Code. I described what I wanted and gave feedback on every render, Claude wrote and changed the code. A few example prompts are at the end of this README.

## What it shows

- the path from the internet through the ISP router (with its real ports) and the firewall to the core switch
- every switch port with the VLANs on it (tall bar = untagged, short bars = tagged)
- cables whose **line width is the negotiated link speed** (10G / 2.5G / 1G / 100M), trunks drawn as a white cable with a dark core
- the devices with name, type, model, IP · hostname and OS
- the Proxmox host with its hardware, the VMs/CTs outside the DMZ, the TrueNAS pools (disks, vdevs, usage) and every DMZ container with its CT ID, IP and hostname
- containers that run several apps as one card with a row per app
- what's open to the internet, a legend, the networks table and a small "media pipeline" explainer

## How it works

- `inventory.yaml` holds everything the picture shows: VLANs, devices, switch ports, port forwards, hardware, containers, pools.
- `build.py` draws the diagram as SVG with hand-placed coordinates, embeds the icons and converts it to PNG with `rsvg-convert`. Text widths for a few labels are measured with Pillow from the real font, so tabs and badges fit their text.
- **Redaction:** by default the real domain is replaced with `redacted.com` and SSIDs get generic names, so the PNG can be posted publicly. `python3 build.py --unredacted` renders a private version with the real values from `inventory.yaml`.

## Requirements

- Python 3 with **PyYAML** (Pillow is optional, but makes label widths exact)
- **rsvg-convert** (librsvg) for the PNG
- the fonts **Fira Sans** and **Fira Code** installed (found via fontconfig)

On Arch/CachyOS: `pacman -S python-yaml python-pillow librsvg ttf-fira-sans ttf-fira-code`
On Debian/Ubuntu: `apt install python3-yaml python3-pil librsvg2-bin fonts-firacode` plus Fira Sans

## Usage

```bash
python3 fetch_icons.py          # downloads the service icons into icons/ (once)
python3 build.py                # → out/homelab.svg + out/homelab.png (redacted)
python3 build.py --unredacted   # → out/homelab-unredacted.svg + .png
```

The service icons are **not** in this repo, `fetch_icons.py` downloads them from [homarr-labs/dashboard-icons](https://github.com/…

**WQ Files** is a file browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26
and 27. "WQ" stands for worse_query, the sandbox technique it is built on. It
reaches other apps' and system containers with no jailbreak and no kernel
exploit. Tested on iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.

**iOS 26 (26.0 to 26.7.2):** supported since 0.7; tested on 26.7.1. worse_query reaches the app, extension, daemon and app group
containers there, but not System Data or the system groups, so WQ Files hides
those two and the Cache Cleaner has no crash-log section. A full inode scan
would take most of an hour on iOS 26, so App Data, Extension Data and App
Groups are listed from the LaunchServices database instead (found once and
remembered). Internal Daemons aren't in that database: the first scan for them
takes long, later ones only check new files. Apps, backups, restores, clearing
app data, the Cache Cleaner and the file browser work as on iOS 27. App icons
don't: iOS 26 hands WQ Files only placeholder icons and doesn't let it read
other apps' bundles, so apps show symbol tiles.

WQ Files is available in English, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese
(Brazil), Russian, Polish, Turkish, Korean, Arabic and Simplified Chinese. It follows
the device language; **Language** in WQ Files' Settings picks another, used
from the next start.

## What it opens

- **App Data**: every app's data container (`Containers/Data/Application`),
  shown with the app's name, bundle ID and icon instead of a UUID.
- **App Groups**: shared group containers.
- **Extension Data** and **Internal Daemons**.
- **App Bundles**: each installed app's bundle container
  (`/var/containers/Bundle/Application`) with its `.app`, labeled with the
  app's name; also from Apps: long-press an app → **Open App Bundle**. Shown
  only where iOS lets WQ Files open these folders (the startup check tries;
  iOS 26 and 27.0.1 don't).
- **System Data**: `/var/containers/Data/System` (listing only; its contents
  are owned by root).
- **System Groups**: the parent cannot be listed on 27.0.1, so known container
  names are tried one by one; tap **+** to try another name. Covers the
  MobileGestalt cache and the configuration-profiles (Supervision) folder.
- **Go to Path** for any absolute path.

The container parents can't be listed, so App Data, Extension Data and App
Groups come from the LaunchServices database, which lists every installed
app's and extension's containers. It is found once (among the newest files,
usually within seconds) and remembered. Internal Daemons, and the app folders
when the database can't be read, need a scan of every file id (`fsgetpath`,
the way KAMUI does it): minutes on a well-used device the first time, so WQ
Files asks before it starts and shows a scan window; later scans only check
new files.

## Tools

- **Apps**: every app with its data size. Back up an app's **Documents and
  Library**, restore the latest backup (also from **App Backups**: long-press the app → Restor…

Goldoire/fefw-recomp.content:
# fefw-recomp

A native Windows PC port of **Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave** (Nintendo Switch 2), made by static recompilation. The game's code is
translated to C++ and compiled into a regular Windows program, which runs on a small runtime that stands in for the console's system
software and draws with Vulkan. It is not an emulator.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included or downloadable here.** This project contains only its own tools and runtime. To play, you need your
> own legally dumped copy of the game; everything that reads the game happens on your PC. See [LEGAL.md](LEGAL.md).
>
> Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo or Intelligent Systems.

## Features

- Runs natively on Windows, with no emulator in between
- 60 or 120 FPS modes, any output resolution, render scale and a temporal upscaler
- Ultrawide (21:9, 32:9 or any wider shape): a wider view with the menus and HUD kept at 16:9 in the centre
- Windowed, borderless or fullscreen
- Keyboard or any controller, with matching button prompts
- An in-game settings overlay (**F1**)
- A launcher that sets everything up from your dump, with nothing else to install

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- A 64-bit CPU with SSE4.2 and POPCNT: an Intel Core i3 / i5 / i7 (2008) or newer, or an AMD FX (2011) / Ryzen or newer. Setup builds the game for your processor: CPUs with FMA3 (Intel Haswell 2013, AMD Piledriver 2012 and newer) get the faster build, older ones such as Sandy Bridge, Ivy Bridge and Xeon E5 v1 / v2 a compatible build that plays the same, a little slower. Older processors (Core 2, AMD Phenom) are not supported; Setup and `fefw.exe` say so instead of crashing
- A GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and an up-to-date driver
- 16 GB of RAM and about 30 GB of free disk space
- Your own decrypted dump of the game at update **131072**, in one of these forms:
  - a folder with `exefs\` and `romfs\`
  - a dump folder with `base\` and `updates\<version>\`
  - a [`.nup`](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) package

## Getting started

1. Download `fefw-recomp-<version>-win64.zip` from the [Releases](../../releases) page and extract it to its own folder.
2. Run `fefw-launcher.exe`.
3. On **Setup**, choose your dump folder (or **.nup** file) and press **Set up**. The launcher checks your files, builds the game on
   your PC and prepares the shaders. The first setup takes a while; you can **Pause** it and continue later.
4. Press **Play**.

Your saves are in the `save\` folder next to the launcher.

### Linux and Steam Deck

Download `fefw-recomp-<version>-linux-x64.tar.gz` instead, extract it and run `fefw-launcher.AppImage`; the steps are the same. The
game runs through Proton: Play needs Steam with a Proton installed, [umu-launcher](https://github.com/Open-Wine-Components/umu-launcher) (`umu-run`) or Wine, or
press **Add to Steam** on the Play page and start it from Steam (also in the Steam Deck's Game Mode). After an update, run Set up in
the launcher (Desktop Mode on a Deck) before playing …

# lot-map

A mod for Claude Code: a live map of the work, in a pane beside the chat. Every tool call, model step, hook and skill sends a pulse from the centre to its station, so you see memory, files, shell, web and agents at work instead of reading a list of commands.

![The map during a work session](docs/demo.gif)

*A made-up session replayed through the mod's own drawing code. [Video (MP4)](docs/demo.mp4).*

## Install

At the prompt of a terminal session:

```
/plugin install lot-map --marketplace alexeyw/lot-map
```

Answer `y` to add the marketplace, then choose a scope. From a shell:

```bash
claude plugin install lot-map --marketplace alexeyw/lot-map
```

If it answers that the plugin is not found in any marketplace, add the marketplace first:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add alexeyw/lot-map
claude plugin install lot-map@lot-map
```

In the desktop app: click **+** next to the prompt box, then **Plugins**, **Add marketplace** with `alexeyw/lot-map`, then **Add plugin**.

The pane opens by itself when a session starts. In a terminal it needs at least 144 columns, otherwise type `/lot-map`, and it draws text only unless you ask for the map's picture: see [In a terminal](#in-a-terminal). Built and tested on Claude Code 2.1.321 on macOS; users report it working on Windows as well.

## Updating

From a shell:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace update lot-map
claude plugin update lot-map@lot-map
```

Then start a new session. The first command is needed: without it the second one reports the installed version as the latest.

What each version changed is in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## What lights up

| Station | When |
| --- | --- |
| You | your messages, questions and files sent to you |
| Model | each model request, context compaction |
| Memory | Claude Code's memory folder, plus whatever you name in the options |
| Files | Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, and shell commands that work on files and nothing else: they read, search, move, delete or edit in place (`cat`, `grep`, `mv`, `rm`, `sed`, `tee`, `find … -delete`) |
| Shell | every other shell command |
| Network | web fetch and search, MCP servers, and shell commands known to reach the network: `curl`, `gh`, `ssh`, `rsync`, `git push`, `npm install`, `docker pull` and the like, also inside `$(…)` |
| Browser | browser tools |
| Agents | subagents and workflows; their own calls start from this station |
| Skills | skills and tool search |
| Hooks | settings hooks that refuse a call, ask for permission, add context or take a moment |

On Windows the PowerShell tool is read the same way as Bash, with PowerShell's own names: `Get-Content` and `Select-String` light Files, `Invoke-WebRequest` lights Network. A program run by its full path is read by its name, also from a quoted path with a space, and `CURL.EXE` is `curl`.

The shell stations go by the command's name, not by what it does: a script that opens a connection itself, such as `python -c "…"`, shows as Shell. A command behi…

# line-art-animation

A Claude skill and a small TypeScript library for animated line-art components:
ink-on-paper figures that walk, ride and react, in scenes that run from day to night.
Everything is drawn live in SVG, so it stays sharp at any size and responds to the
pointer.

![A Japanese street drawn in line art, going from late afternoon to night](media/village.gif)

| Day | Night |
|---|---|
| ![The village at midday](media/day.png) | ![The village at night with lit windows](media/night.png) |

## What's in the repo

| | |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md`, `references/` | The skill: workflow, the rules that make the style work, and guides for style, motion, scenes, verification, matching a reference clip and rendering video. |
| `lib/` | Four dependency-free TypeScript modules: drawing primitives (`ink.ts`), a walk/run solver (`gait.ts`), springs, pendulums and wind (`motion.ts`), and a time-of-day palette (`daynight.ts`). |
| `examples/walker/` | One figure in about 150 lines: a man with a briefcase walks across the card; click him and he tips his hat. |
| `examples/village/` | A full scene: a street of machiya, a tea house and a bath house by a canal, villagers on schedules, a cat, birds, a boatman, lit windows and reflections, about a dozen interactions. |
| `scripts/` | Deterministic frame capture for video, and tools for measuring a reference clip. |

## Install the skill

For Claude Code, clone it into your skills folder:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/JDhruv14/line-art-animation ~/.claude/skills/line-art-animation
```

or into `.claude/skills/` inside a single project. Then ask for what you want, for example:

- "Make a line art animation of a bakery at dawn: a baker carrying trays, steam from the oven, a cat in the window."
- "Turn this clip into a looping line-art component, matching its walk exactly." (attach or link the clip)
- "Add a day-night cycle to the scene and render a 30-second 1080p video."

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, copies `lib/` into your project, shows one figure for approval
before building the rest, and checks motion frame by frame before handing it over.

## Run the examples

Requires Node 22.18 or newer.

```sh
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
```

In the village, drag the sun or moon across the sky to change the time, move the pointer
to make wind, and click people, windows, lanterns, the wind chime, the cat, the birds or
the water. URL flags: `?start=0.9` sets the starting time (0 is midnight, 0.5 noon),
`?tau=0.5` pins it, `?day=30` makes a full day last 30 seconds, `?debug` steps time by hand.

```sh
npm run typecheck  # strict for lib/ and the walker
npm run build
```

into a scene with a transform. Limbs are two open pen strokes around a curve through the

adriadam10/mkw-recomp.content: # mkw-recomp A static recompilation of *Mario Kart World* (Nintendo Switch 2, versions 1.0.0 and 1.8.0) into a native PC program for Linux and Windows. It needs your own copy of the game, dumped from your own console: nothing of the game is in this repository or in its releases. **It is a recompilation, not an emulator.** The game's AArch64 code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled for the PC's CPU (x86-64, or AArch64 on Linux); there is no CPU interpreter or JIT. The GPU is not emulated either: NVN2, the Switch 2 graphics API, is reimplemented on top of Vulkan at the API level, and the game's SM86 shaders are translated to SPIR-V ahead of time. Nintendo SDK functions (`nn::*`) are replaced by name with our own code. ## Status Early, and moving fast. On 12/11/2026: - It boots, plays the intro movies, goes through the menus and races, on Linux and on Windows (x86-64), and on Linux on AArch64 (its own AppImage; tested on an Adreno 740 handheld). - The start screen sets the game up from your copy on your machine (generates and compiles the C, translates the shaders, warms up the pipeline cache) and holds every setting: display, graphics quality, controls, hacks. - Races run at 60 fps on high-end GPUs and at 30 on mid-range ones; see [Performance](#performance). - Known problems: a few menus (mode, character and vehicle select) still need work, the kart's shadow misses a frame now and then, some audio cuts during movies, and on some AMD drivers the GPU can hang. There is no online play. ## Roadmap The main open work, in order; the details are in [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md). - **60 fps in races.** Today a race frame is a serial chain: the game finishes its frame (~3 ms\*), then the Vulkan back end records the game's big submit (~19 ms\*), then the GPU runs it (~10 ms\*), and only then does the next frame start. Recording is on the critical path, so the work is recording with less CPU: dynamic state only when it changes, draw caches across frames, parallel recording, and a faster game thread. - **The picture as on the console**: the last shader translator bugs, the kart's shadow, push constants, zero Vulkan validation errors. - **Every menu checked** against the console: mode, character and vehicle select are next. - **No GPU hangs** and less GPU memory, then loading without stutter and a Linux package for non-rolling distributions. - **1.8.0 on par with 1.0.0**: its ultrawide aspect, shadow map size and fixed seed ([#19](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/issues/19)). \* Measured on 09/11/2026 on our test machine: Radeon 660M APU (Ryzen 5 7535HS), Linux, 720p internal resolution. ## Performance Measured frame times, each with its date, are in [docs/performance.md](docs/performance.md). To add your machine, open a [performance report](https://github.com/adriadam10/mkw-recomp/issues/new?template=performance.yml): it goes in…

# worse_query

### A sandbox escape for iOS 26.0 - 26.7.2 / 27.2.

This is a proof-of-concept for developers and isn't useful by itself.

worse_query is the direct successor to [bad_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/bad_query) and essentially replaces it. To use worse_query, you'll have to set up an App Group container for your app.

worse_query can access these paths:

```
/var/containers/Data/System (iOS 27)
/var/containers/Shared/SystemGroup/* (iOS 27)
/var/mobile/Containers/Data/Application/*
/var/mobile/Containers/Data/InternalDaemon/*
/var/mobile/Containers/Data/PluginKitPlugin/*
/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup/*
/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup (iOS 27)
```

<sub>**This is not relevant to a jailbreak and never will be.** Please don't mislead people into believing otherwise.</sub>

luobinger/PerkRadar.content:
# PerkRadar

PerkRadar 是一个可自行部署的优惠线索聚合器。它定时读取固定的公开 RSS、Atom、JSON 和 Markdown 来源，把标题、原文链接和短摘要整理到一个轻量的 SQLite 数据库，再用网页看板帮助你搜索、筛选、收藏和标记已领。

条目来自公开订阅源，可能包含闲聊、求购、推广或失效活动。分类由标题规则推断，不构成优惠真实性、有效期或领取资格的核验；请以原文和活动官方说明为准。

## 部署方式

推荐让 Personal Agent 协助部署，也可按下方步骤自行运行。PerkRadar 适用于单机单实例部署，需要常驻 Node 进程和可写的本地 SQLite 数据目录。

- **本机使用**：默认绑定 `127.0.0.1:38471`，未启用认证时仅用于可信的单用户环境。
- **公网使用**：通过 TLS 反向代理访问，并设置至少 32 字符的随机 `PERKRADAR_ACCESS_TOKEN`；应用端口继续仅对宿主机开放。

外部推送可由调用方另行集成，PerkRadar 本身不发送通知。

## 快速开始

### 环境要求

- **Docker 方式**：Docker Engine 和 Docker Compose v2.24 或更高版本，也可使用 Docker Desktop；宿主机无需另装 Node.js。
- **直接运行源码**：Node.js 22.13 或更高版本，以及 npm。项目使用 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，依赖解析锁定在 `package-lock.json` 中。

### 获取源码

```bash
git clone https://github.com/luobinger/PerkRadar.git
cd PerkRadar
```

### 用 Docker 运行

此命令构建生产镜像并启动容器，SQLite 数据保存在宿主机的 `./data`。容器以非 root 的 `node` 用户（uid 1000）运行，宿主数据目录须允许该用户写入；权限设置见[运维文档](docs/OPERATIONS.md)。

Compose 可读取项目根目录的 `.env`。该文件被 Git 和镜像构建忽略；包含凭据时应使用 `600` 权限。配置项见下方[访问控制与配置](#访问控制与配置)。

```bash
docker compose -p perkradar up -d --build
```

打开 [http://127.0.0.1:38471/](http://127.0.0.1:38471/)。宿主端口被占用时，可只替换宿主端口，容器内端口仍为 `38471`：

```bash
HOST_PORT=38481 docker compose -p perkradar up -d --build
```

此时访问 [http://127.0.0.1:38481/](http://127.0.0.1:38481/)。

### 用 npm 开发

在项目目录安装依赖：

```bash
npm ci
```

以下示例使用独立端口和开发数据库，避免与默认部署共用：

```bash
DATA_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/perkradar-dev" PORT=38481 npm run dev
```

打开 [http://127.0.0.1:38481/](http://127.0.0.1:38481/)。调度器会抓取真实来源；端口如已占用，需换用空闲端口。未显式设置时，监听地址为 `127.0.0.1:38471`，数据库为 `./data/deals.db`。

开发环境的 `/demo` 使用示例数据展示界面，不代表真实抓取结果；生产 Docker 镜像不包含此路由。

## 用 GitHub Pages 查看定时快照

仓库包含 `Snapshot to Pages` 工作流，可在 GitHub Actions 中每两小时抓取固定来源并发布静态查看器，不需要常驻服务器。启用时在仓库 **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source** 选择 **GitHub Actions**，再到 **Actions → Snapshot to Pages → Run workflow** 手动运行首次发布。之后从工作流的部署结果打开实际站点地址。定时任务可能被 GitHub 延迟；公开仓库长期无活动时，GitHub 也可能暂停定时任务。

静态站点包含公开标题、原文链接、来源和时间，任何知道站点地址的人都可访问；它不使用本机服务的访问令牌。收藏与已领仍只存在当前浏览器，并按站点隔离，不会同步本机看板。可选的 `JINA_API_KEY` 应放在仓库 Actions Secrets 中，不会写入页面。

静态查看器支持标题搜索、来源和分类筛选、收藏、已领及本轮新增，默认隐藏“其他”，可通过“查看全部线索”展开。首次发布没有比较基线，不标新增。每轮临时库抓到的结果会与上次成功发布的公开快照合并，继续遵守 7 天在架及活动截止时间；来源失败时保留该来源仍有效的旧条目。全失败时保留上次有效快照的原始抓取时间，另显示最近尝试失败；首次运行全部失败则停止发布。历史基线以 Actions artifact 保留最多 90 天，超过保留期后重新建立基线。

页面可见时每 30 秒读取最新静态结果，重新聚焦时检查；时间到达新鲜期或活动截止边界时也会更新提示和列表。这里的“刷新快照”只重读已发布文件，不触发外部抓取。

## 访问控制与配置

| 配置项 | 用途与默认行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `PERKRADAR_ACCESS_TOKEN` | 本应用的共享访问令牌。未设置或为空时关闭认证；非空但少于 32 字符时拒绝访问 |
| `PERKRADAR_SECURE_COOKIE` | 生产会话默认启用 `Secure`；仅可信本机 HTTP 调试可设为 `0` |
| `JINA_API_KEY` | LINUX DO 来源使用的 Jina 凭据，与应用访问令牌无关；不配置时匿名请求可能受额度和限流影响 |
| `JINA_API_KEY_FILE` | 从文件读取 Jina 凭据；容器部署须单独挂载可读文件，仅放在宿主 `.secrets/` 下不会自动挂载 |
| `DATA_DIR` | 直接运行时默认 `./data`；Compose 固定为容器内 `/data`，挂载宿主 `./data` |
| `HOST` / `PORT` | 直接运行时默认 `127.0.0.1` / `38471`；Compose 使用 `HOST_PORT` 更改宿主端口 |

其他配置项见[运维文档](docs/OPERATIONS.md)。

### 登录与退出

启用认证后，首页与数据 API 均要求有效凭据。浏览器在 `/login` 输入令牌，获得有效期 8 小时的签名会话，cookie 带 `HttpOnly`、…

# STE80 Humanizer

[![skills.sh installs](https://skills.sh/b/Dodaios/ste80-humanizer)](https://skills.sh/Dodaios/ste80-humanizer) [![validate](https://github.com/Dodaios/ste80-humanizer/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Dodaios/ste80-humanizer/actions/workflows/validate.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

STE80 Humanizer makes AI-written text read like a careful person wrote it, without changing what it says. It combines two methods:

1. **The humanizer method.** Remove the 26 tells from Wikipedia's [Signs of AI writing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Signs_of_AI_writing), in the catalog of [blader/humanizer](https://github.com/blader/humanizer).
2. **Karpathy's STE80 method.** Rebuild the sentences "80% of the way to ASD-STE100", the controlled English of aircraft maintenance manuals.

**Before:**
> Great question! Kubernetes liveness probes are a powerful mechanism that enables the kubelet to determine whether a container is healthy — and it's not just a health check, it's your first line of defense. When a probe fails, the container will be automatically restarted by the kubelet, ensuring that your application remains available. However, it's important to note that misconfigured probes could potentially cause cascading restarts, so parameters like `initialDelaySeconds` and `failureThreshold` should be carefully tuned.
>
> Get this right, and your cluster heals itself.

**After:**
> A liveness probe tells the kubelet if a container is healthy. If the probe fails, the kubelet restarts the container. This keeps the application available.
>
> A bad probe can also cause many restarts. For example, a timeout that is too short makes healthy containers fail the probe. To prevent this, set `initialDelaySeconds` and `failureThreshold` to values that fit your application.

The goal is text that people read easily. Getting past AI detectors is not a goal.

## Why two passes

Most humanizers only remove phrases. The text loses "Great question!" and "seamless", but it keeps long sentences that carry three ideas, hide the actor and stack hedges. It still reads like AI. You can see it in the worked example in [SKILL.md](SKILL.md):

| Step | What is left |
|---|---|
| Original | Chatbot opener, dash, "not just X", "-ing" rider, "however", "could potentially", dramatic closer |
| After Pass 1 (tells) | "...the container will be automatically restarted by the kubelet, which keeps your application available. Misconfigured probes can cause cascading restarts, so parameters ... should be carefully tuned." Clean words, but heavy sentences. |
| After Pass 2 (STE80) | Short sentences, one idea each, active voice, the instruction apart from the description. |

# LingBot-Touch: A Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Tactile Representation Learning

Bing Han, Yichuan Peng, Haoyu Dong, Yuanmeng Hu, Yongyi Jia, Fangjing Wang, Kecheng Zheng,
Yiming Zhang, Yanhong Zeng, Xiaoqing Zhang, Chen Song, Rundong Zou, Anqi Dong,
Yuan Guan, Ka Leong Cheng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Wei Ning†

We aim to bridge heterogeneous tactile sensor signals and real-world dexterous robotic manipulation, enabling tactile experience to transfer across hardware platforms and tasks. To this end, we introduce **LingBot-Touch**, a JEPA-based tactile representation model built around a shared Transformer and latent representation prediction from spatiotemporal tactile context. LingBot-Touch enables a rich understanding of spatiotemporal tactile signals across sensing modalities while supporting high-frequency inference and cross-task transfer. We demonstrate four key properties: 1. **Unified.** Heterogeneous tactile data from multiple sources mutually enhance representation learning within a unified latent space. 2. **Transferable.** Even when pretrained on entirely different tactile sensors, LingBot-Touch transfers to downstream tactile sensors and real-world dexterous robotic hands without any additional training. 3. **Efficient.** Even with its smallest ViT backbone, LingBot-Touch supports high-frequency downstream inference with a lightweight architecture. 4. **Scalable.** Scaling the amount of tactile training data yields continued performance improvements on both downstream tactile tasks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks. ## Contents - [Pretraining](#LingBot-Touch-Pre-Training) - [Open Weights](#Models) - [Usage of LingBot-Touch Representations](#Usage-of-LingBot-Touch-Representations) - [Getting Started](#Getting-Started) - [Environment Setup](#Environment-Setup) - [Inference Steps](#Inference-Steps) - [Example](#Example) - [License](#License) - [Citation](#Citation) - [Detailed Data Interface Guide](#Detailed-Data-Interface-Guide) ## LingBot-Touch Pre-Training

Kernarium
===

Run a real Linux kernel natively on iOS, through the magic of [User-mode Linux](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User-mode_Linux).

## Apps

### Andarium

An Android emulator app built on the Kernarium runtime is available in [TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/qyPvJTUE). Source code is available under [`Andarium/`](/Andarium/).

The TestFlight beta only has 10,000 tester slots and gets filled up quickly. Alternatively, you can sideload IPA from [releases](https://github.com/imxieyi/Kernarium/releases).

### Kernarium

A generic Linux emulator app capable of running various Linux distributions. It's still at an early stage of development and isn't ready for release yet. Source code is available under [`Kernarium/`](/Kernarium/).

## Overview

The User-mode Linux kernel is compiled to native arm64 code, then linked to an iOS runtime framework. The kernel runs natively without emulation. Userspace programs are emulated using an [iSH](https://github.com/ish-app/ish)-style threaded interpreter, with SMP support. Guest GPU acceleration is provided by [KosmicKrisp](https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/kosmickrisp.html), a translation layer from Vulkan to Metal.

This emulator architecture sits between a full system emulator (like [UTM](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM)) and a full userspace emulator (like [iSH](https://github.com/ish-app/ish)). It combines the benefits of a real Linux kernel and a userspace emulator that only needs to emulate userspace code. It's capable of running advanced workloads including Docker containers, Linux desktops, Wine/Proton and a full Android system at decent speed on modern iOS devices.

## Features

- Kernel
    - Mainline 6.18 LTS kernel for both Linux and Android guests
    - Supports most kernel features, including namespaces, SELinux and more
- CPU emulation
    - Supports `arm64`, `arm32`, `x86_64` guest instructions
    - Both interpreter and JIT execution modes (interpreter-only for TestFlight release)
- GPU acceleration
    - Vulkan 1.4 via [KosmicKrisp](https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/kosmickrisp.html)
    - OpenGL 4.6 & GLES 3.2 via [Zink](https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/zink.html)
    - Hardware video encoding and decoding (H.264, HEVC) via [VideoToolbox](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/videotoolbox)
- Storage
    - Supports virtual disks via UBD driver, with discard support
    - Supports any Linux filesystem including ext2/3/4, erofs, xfs, ...
    - Supports loop devices and FUSE
- Network
    - Full Linux networking stack
    - Guest network access via [libslirp](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/slirp/libslirp)

## Build or Embed

Point your coding agent at this repo if you want to build the project or embed its runtime in other apps. The agent guide is [`AGENTS.md`](/AGENTS.md), and the documentation is under [`docs/`](/docs/).

Building Android system image requires a powerful remote x86_64 Linux building machine ([requirements](https://source.android.com/docs/setup/start/re…

# chrome-capture

Record a Chrome tab at 60-120fps (up to 2160p) straight to a AV1 `.mp4`. Tab audio too. No ffmpeg.

```bash
npx chrome-capture https://paulirish.github.io/chrome-capture/ demo.mp4 4s
```

## Chrome 153+ has a native MP4 tab recorder! 😻

For the past ~decade, [`Page.startScreencast`](https://chromedevtools.github.io/devtools-protocol/tot/Page/#method-startScreencast) was the only way to get video frames out of CDP. That API is from ~2013, built so DevTools could show a live preview of a USB-tethered Android. (So good!) Both Playwright (`recordVideo`) and Puppeteer (`page.screencast()`) built their video capture on top of it: Chrome JPEG-encodes each frame, base64s it into JSON over CDP, waits for an ack, and the library pipes those JPEGs into `ffmpeg`. It's served us well.

In Sept 2026… the new [`Page.startScreenRecording`](https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/7736461) landed (thx alex rudenko!). Frames go **straight from the compositor** to an out-of-process encoder over shared memory, and Chrome **writes AV1 into the mp4** as it goes (plus optional tab audio). 💅 Stopping is ~instant because the encoding is already done (no multi-second `ffmpeg` flush at the end). And you can start/stop recording whenever you want: log in, warm up the page, then record just the interaction.

**In short: It's hot. It's good. really good.**

<!-- senna-800kg-1920x1080-120fps.mp4 -->
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e17ffe7e-e868-40d5-adc9-df85eeb3dae8

_(Thx [github.com/Sam1983Aing/senna-800kg](https://github.com/Sam1983Aing/senna-800kg) for this Gemini Argon generation.)_

Puppeteer v25.10+ wraps this in an experimental `page.record()` (deprecating `page.screencast()`). _(Update: Nov 10th... Playwright now has [an open PR](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/44046) ([#43999](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/43999)) bringing `Page.startScreenRecording` to Chromium! :fingers_crossed:)_

Feel free to install this from npm.. or tbh just point your agent at [`src/index.ts`](./src/index.ts) and steal the implementation. It's tiny.

## CLI

```bash
# 720p @ 60fps for 4s, with tab audio
npx chrome-capture https://paulirish.github.io/chrome-capture/ demo.mp4 4s

# 1080p @ 120fps (needs a 120Hz display and headful Chrome, e.g. a ProMotion MacBook)
npx chrome-capture https://paulirish.github.io/chrome-capture/ 120fps.mp4 5s --fps=120 --width=1920 --height=1080 --headful

# Record the page with DevTools open next to it
npx chrome-capture https://paulirish.github.io/chrome-capture/ devtools.mp4 5s --with-devtools
```

The CLI records audio by default and runs headless (`--headless=new`) for `<= 60fps`, automatically switching to `--headful` on macOS when `--fps > 60` so Chrome can lock onto ProMotion's 120Hz `CVDisplayLink`. `--help` for the rest.

## Playwright, Puppeteer, or raw CDP

`startRecording()` takes a Playwright `Page`, a Puppeteer `Page`, or a CDP session. It defaults to 60fps and works with…

# Rewind for X 推文回看

**[从 Chrome 网上应用店安装](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rewind-for-x/ejigodeghgpnkcicikcfmhiedgdecdal?hl=zh-CN)** · 官网：<https://rewindforx.com>

X 的首页推荐一刷新，刚才看到的好帖子就找不回来了。这个 Chrome 扩展会默默记下你在首页**看到过**的每条推文，随时可以回看。

- **只记看过的**：推文在屏幕上露出一半以上才算，记下作者、正文、图片、引用、转帖人和链接
- **只记首页**：推荐和关注时间线；广告、推文详情页、个人主页都不记
- **随手打开**：右下角的按钮（在 X 的 Grok / 聊天按钮上方）、工具栏图标或 `Alt+Shift+R`。最新的在最上面，按浏览时段分组
- **搜索和筛选**：关键词搜索，按图片、视频、引用、转帖筛选；中文前后有没有空格都能搜到
- **搜图中文字**：打开后，图片里的文字也能搜到。识别在本机完成，第一次使用时下载几 MB 的识别数据
- **不打扰首页**：点推文在新标签页打开，首页不会再刷新一次
- **手机布局**：窄屏和触屏下，抽屉铺满屏幕，按钮避开底部标签栏和发帖按钮
- **数据只在本机**：存在 `chrome.storage.local`，最多 3000 条，可一键清空

非 X 官方产品，与 X Corp. 无关。

## 安装

从 [Chrome 网上应用店](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rewind-for-x/ejigodeghgpnkcicikcfmhiedgdecdal?hl=zh-CN)安装。

或者从源码加载：

1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`，打开右上角「开发者模式」
2. 「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择本目录
3. 打开或刷新 x.com/home

## 测试

需要 Playwright 和 Chromium。测试用模拟 X 页面结构的页面，跑真实的扩展。

```
node test/e2e.mjs     # 记录、刷新后保留、忽略广告和非首页、跳过翻译插件的译文、抽屉、搜索、筛选、清空、深色主题
node test/mobile.mjs  # 手机布局：按钮位置、全屏抽屉、触屏尺寸
node test/ocr.mjs     # 搜图中文字：下载进度、识别、搜索、开关（要联网下载识别数据）
```

## 目录

- `background.js`：工具栏图标；在后台逐张识别图片
- `content.js`：在 x.com 上记录推文，以及抽屉界面
- `ocr/`：图片文字识别，[Tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) 7（Apache-2.0）跑在 offscreen 页面里。识别数据从 jsDelivr 下载，存在 IndexedDB
- `tools/icons.py`：生成 `icons/`

## 上架 Chrome 网上应用店

- `tools/pack.sh`：打包成 `dist/rewind-for-x-<版本>.zip`，只含扩展运行需要的文件
- `node tools/store-assets.mjs`：重新生成 `store/screenshots/`（1280×800，中英文 × 浅色 / 深色 / 搜索）和 `store/promo/`（440×280、1400×560 宣传图），图里的帖子都是虚构的
- `store/listing.md`：商店描述（中英文），以及隐私表单要填的每一段文字
- `store/privacy-policy.html`：隐私政策，线上版本在 <https://rewindforx.com/privacy/>

## 官网

<https://rewindforx.com>，源文件在 `site/`：英文首页、`zh/` 中文页、`privacy/` 隐私政策。托管在 Cloudflare Workers 静态资源上，`site-worker/index.js` 把 www 跳转到裸域。部署：

```
npx wrangler deploy
```

# muse.ai 注册 / 邀请码兑换 协议分析

补充一下，记得用JP 节点， JP 不需要绑卡，直接过

纯 HTTP 实现 muse.ai 的注册与邀请码兑换流程，不依赖浏览器。本文记录的是通过抓包逐字段比对得出的协议细节。

## 快速开始

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp config.example.json config.json   # 填入邮箱与可选代理
python example_register.py
```

## 目录结构

```
musepy/
  client.py    注册 + 兑换的完整协议客户端
  falco.py     行为埋点上报（可选）
  caa.py       注册漏斗事件上报（可选）
example_register.py   端到端示例
config.example.json   配置模板
```

## 协议流程

```
GET  /                                   拿初始 cookie
POST /api/auth/native/restart            → 201 {csrf_token}
POST /api/auth/native/send-otp           → 201
POST /api/auth/native/confirm-otp        → 200 {registration_state:"completion_required"}
POST /api/auth/native/register-completion→ 200 {auth_meta_session:{frl_access_token, frl_account_id}}
POST /api/hatch/accept-tos               → 200（激活会话，必须）
GET  /api/hatch/invite                   → 200 表示账号有效
POST /api/hatch/vm/wake                  → 200（必须，否则兑换误报 invalid）
POST /api/hatch/stateful-sharing         → 200
POST /api/hatch/invite-code/redeem       → 200 {redemptionStatus:"redeemed"}
POST /api/hatch/invite                   → 200 {code}（刮出自己的码）
```

## 几个容易踩的坑

### 1. `confirm-otp` 必须带 `supports_muse_link_transparency: true`

```json
{"otp_code":"123456","remember_device":true,"supports_muse_link_transparency":true}
```

### 2. `register-completion` 的姓名字段语义

```json
{
  "date_of_birth": "1993-11-14",
  "first_name": "三郎",     // 名（given name）
  "last_name": "近藤",      // 姓（family name）
  "tos_content_version": "ntm_create_account:default_v1_meta_account_v3+docs_v2",
  "remember_device": true
}
```

`first_name` 是名、`last_name` 是姓，与直觉相反。生日早于约 18 年前会返回 403——同一会话同一份姓名，只把生日从 2013 改成 1993 就能从 403 变 200。

### 3. `restart` 的 body 不是空对象

```json
{"resume": false}
```

### 4. `accept-tos` 是会话激活开关

注册完成后 `GET /api/hatch/invite` 会是 403。必须先调 `accept-tos`，且 `disclosure_text` 要填完整日文文案（不是随便一个字符串），之后 invite 才返回 200。

### 5. `vm/wake` 缺失会让兑换误报

不调 `vm/wake` 直接兑换，即使是有效码也会返回：

```json
{"success":false,"reason":"invalid","detail":"この招待コードは存在しません"}
```

需要先从已登录页面提取 `vmId`：

```python
re.search(r'vmId[\\"]*:[\\"]*([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})', html)
```

### 6. 兑换失败原因的含义

| reason | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `redeemed` | 成功 |
| `already_redeemed` | 本账号已经兑换过一个码 |
| `used_up` | 该码达到 30 次使用上限 |
| `invalid` | 码不存在，或没调 `vm/wake` |

## Cookie

注册成功后 `hatch_sess` 由 `register-completion` 的响应头下发（约 886 字符），这是后续所有 hatch 接口的凭证。`hatch_vml` 在注册阶段一直是被清空状态（`Max-Age=0`），不属于必需项。

## 埋点说明

站点前端会上报两类遥测：

- **falco**（`POST /api/falco`）—— 性能指标与业务交互事件，`machineId` 固定为 `not_set`
- **caa-events**（`POST /api/auth/caa-events`）—— 注册漏斗，通过 `navigator.sendBeacon` 逐步骤上报，同一 `waterfall_id` 贯穿全程

两者都不参与注册判定，缺省不影响流程能跑通。`musepy/falco.py` 与 `musepy/caa.py` 保留了完整实现，可通过配置关闭。

## 使用声明

本项目仅供个人、非商业的学习与研究使用，不采用 MIT 等开源许可证。不得用于商业用途或再分发。实际使用时请遵守目标站点的服务条款与当地法律法规。

# Clash Verge 静态 IP 分流

适用于电脑端 Clash Verge Rev。用自己的机场订阅连接 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 静态代理，给 X、ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等服务提供固定出口。

| 流量 | 出口 |
| --- | --- |
| X（含视频）、ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Cursor 等脚本中列出的域名 | 静态代理 |
| YouTube（含视频、接口和图片） | 普通代理 |
| 其他流量 | 优先使用订阅自己的规则；代理兜底使用普通自动选择 |

## 按需调整

这个脚本提供一套「订阅节点作为前置，再连接静态代理」的分流思路。上面的规则可以作为起点，你可以根据自己的订阅、静态代理和日常使用场景调整。

- **分流策略**：按需增删域名，决定哪些网站走静态出口，哪些继续走普通代理。例如，只让 X 和 ChatGPT 走静态出口，其他服务沿用订阅规则。
- **前置节点**：默认用订阅中的所有节点生成静态链路。你可以在脚本生成 `chains` 的位置筛选候选节点，只让常用地区或实测能稳定连到静态代理的节点参与选线。

## 使用教程

准备一个已经导入 Clash Verge Rev 的订阅，以及你自己的 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 静态代理。订阅的 `proxies` 里需要有节点；只通过 `proxy-providers` 加载节点的订阅需要先展开。

如果你还没有静态代理，可以参考我们使用的 [Webshare 静态代理](https://www.webshare.io/?referral_code=3e8qjz3gzlea)。已有静态代理的话，直接使用你自己的服务即可。

### Webshare 静态 IP 选购示例

进入 Webshare 的套餐配置页面后，按截图选择以下选项。

| 页面选项 | 选择 |
| --- | --- |
| 产品 | `Static Residential`（静态住宅代理） |
| Exclusivity | `Private` |
| Bandwidth | `250 GB` |
| Proxy number | 点击 `Enter a custom quantity`，输入 `1`，并确认右侧 Summary 显示 1 个代理 |
| Pay Yearly | 关闭，按月付款 |

截图中的 **Monthly Cost（月费）和 Pay Today（本次付款）均为 1.50 美元**。如果金额不同，先逐项核对产品、类型、流量、IP 数量和付款周期，尤其注意滑块的第一个刻度是 25，要用自定义数量填 1。选项都一致时，以 Webshare 结账页显示的金额为准。

![Webshare 套餐配置示例，选择 Static Residential、Private、250 GB、1 个 IP，关闭年付，截图月费为 1.50 美元](docs/webshare-static-residential.png)

### 1. 复制完整脚本

打开 [clash-verge-static-ip.js](clash-verge-static-ip.js)，点击文件上方的「复制原始文件」图标，或点「Raw」打开纯文本后全选复制。

### 2. 粘贴到全局扩展脚本

在 Clash Verge Rev 左侧点击「订阅」，打开页面底部右侧的「全局扩展脚本」（Script），位置见下图。如果编辑器里已有脚本，先复制一份保存到本地，再全选并粘贴刚才复制的完整脚本。

![Clash Verge 的订阅页面，红色箭头指向右下方的全局扩展脚本卡片](docs/clash-verge-global-script.png)

### 3. 换成你自己的静态 IP 和账号

**保存前，务必修改脚本顶部的 `staticProxy`。把示例占位值换成你自己购买或搭建的静态代理信息。**

| 字段 | 填写内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `type` | 供应商提供的协议，填写 `"http"` 或 `"socks5"` |
| `server` | 你自己的静态代理 IP 或主机名，替换 `YOUR_PROXY_HOST`。只填地址，端口另填 |
| `port` | 你自己的代理端口，替换示例中的 `8080`，保持为数字 |
| `username` | 你自己的代理用户名，替换 `YOUR_PROXY_USERNAME` |
| `password` | 你自己的代理密码，替换 `YOUR_PROXY_PASSWORD` |

如果供应商要求 HTTP 代理入口使用 TLS，取消 `tls: true` 这一行的注释。填好后的脚本含明文凭据，请只保存在自己的设备。

### 4. 在 Clash Verge 里测试

保存脚本，重新加载当前订阅，再打开左侧「代理」页面，选择右上角的「规则」模式。找到「🔒 静态出口自动选择」，点击组右侧的测速按钮。如果静态链路显示了延迟数字（例如图中的 174 ms），就说明这条链路已连通。

![Clash Verge 的代理页面，红色箭头指向静态链路的测速结果](docs/clash-verge-static-proxy-test.png)

截图里的「静态前置自动选择」对应公开脚本里的「静态出口自动选择」。

界面位置可参照 [Clash Verge Rev 扩展配置与脚本文档](https://www.clashverge.dev/guide/extend.html)。

#### 核对 Claude 的出口 IP

静态链路测速通过后，在浏览器打开 [Claude AI IP 检测](https://ip.net.coffee/claude/)。看页面右上方的「Claude AI 出口 IP」卡片，确认显示的地址与你配置的静态出口 IP 一致。如果地址不同，可以在 Clash Verge 的「连接」页面检查 Claude 相关连接是否命中「静态出口自动选择」。

<details>
<summary>查看检测页面示例</summary>

![Claude AI IP 检测页面，右上方显示 Claude AI 出口 IP](docs/claude-ip-check.png)

</details>

## 自动选线

每个订阅节点都会生成一条「订阅节点 → 静态代理」链路。静态组每 60 秒检测完整链路，所有静态链路不可用时相关请求会失败。普通组每 300 秒检测订阅节点。静态目标使用 TCP，匹配静态域名的 UDP 流量会被拒绝。YouTube 规则优先于 Google 的通用规则。[Mihomo 链式代理文档](https://wiki.metacubex.one/config/proxies/dialer-proxy/)

需要调整域名时，在脚本顶部维护 `staticDomains`、`staticExact`、`youtubeDomains` 和 `youtubeExact`。前两组分别按域名后缀和完整域名匹配静态流量，…

# qiaomu-deepseek-api

一份扫描 PDF、一段录音和一个网页，原本得分别接三个工具。装好这个 Skill 后，可以让 Agent 用你的 DeepSeek API Key 读文档、转写、查网页和生成配音，并拿到可核对的结果。

[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api)](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api/stargazers)
[![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api)](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api/forks)
[![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api)](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api/issues)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api)](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api/commits/main/)
[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api)](LICENSE)

[中文](#安装) · [English](#english)

> 问扫描件「只返回验证编号」→ `CEDAR-63842`，同时返回 `cleanup.deleted: true`。这是随附 CLI 的真接口测试结果。

## 安装

```bash
npx skills add joeseesun/qiaomu-deepseek-api
```

- [ ] 使用支持 Agent Skills 的工具，安装命令需要 Node.js/npm。
- [ ] 运行命令需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本，无需安装 Python 包。
- [ ] 在 [DeepSeek 开放平台](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys) 获取自己的 API Key，通过宿主的密钥配置注入 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。也可以在自己的终端进入 Skill 目录运行 `python3 scripts/deepseek_api.py setup`，隐藏输入并验证后保存到本机专用配置文件。首次执行发现未配置时，Agent 会给出官方申请入口和配置命令，再继续原任务。不要将 Key 发到聊天。

TTS 会在你没指定音色时提供单选卡，在不支持卡片的宿主里用文字选项。两款音色使用同一句话实测，可下载试听：[海星 Stella 女声](assets/voices/stella.mp3) · [暗潮 Tide 男声](assets/voices/tide.mp3)。

## 用法

你可以直接这样说：

- “用 DeepSeek 审一下这个扫描 PDF，告诉我汇款金额和票号。”
- “用 DeepSeek 查官方发布，给我引用和可打开的链接。”
- “用 DeepSeek 以图搜图，查这张公开图片的出处。”
- “用 DeepSeek 把这段 WAV 转文字，再用 Stella 给我的新稿生成配音。”

| 要拿到什么 | 选什么 |
|---|---|
| 搜索结果、网页 Markdown | 独立 Search / Fetch，无需对话模型 |
| 带引用的答案、深度搜索、读链接、以图搜图 | Flash 对话工具 |
| 文档里的内容、表格或插图 | 上传后问答，完成后清理本次上传 |
| 图片/扫描件的逐页文字 | 独立 OCR |
| 音频转写、普通话 WAV 配音 | ASR / TTS，可组合 |

也可以直接跑脚本：

```bash
python3 scripts/deepseek_api.py search 'DeepSeek API site:api-docs.deepseek.com' --count 3
python3 scripts/deepseek_api.py ask-file report.pdf --prompt '列出三项关键数字'
python3 scripts/deepseek_api.py tts --text '你好，欢迎收听。' --voice stella --output demo.wav
```

[完整命令与输出约定](references/commands.md) · [验证与限制](reports/creation-handoff.md)

## 常见问题 · Troubleshooting

| 现象 | 怎么处理 |
|---|---|
| 401 或 `missing_key` | 检查宿主注入的官方 Key；环境变量优先于本机配置。 |
| 402 / 429 | 分别检查账户余额、等待限流缓解。CLI 不会自动重试。 |
| MP3 不能转写 | 先转为 16 位 PCM WAV 或 Ogg Opus，单段最长 120 秒。 |
| 回答有文字但缺来源 | 检查 `tool_calls` / `tool_results`，需要网页正文时直接用 Fetch。 |
| 模型读不懂 PDF 插图 | 使用 `rich_layout_recognition` 或把插图单独作为图片输入，核对颜色、数字和标注。 |

上传或输入的内容会发送给 DeepSeek；工具用量可能收费。本机输入与密钥不会被打包到 Skill。卸载可从 Agent 的技能目录移除本包；如曾运行 `setup`，可自行删除专用凭据文件并在平台撤销 Key。

本地验证用 `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。也可用 [乔木 Meta Skill](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-meta-skill) 的 `validate_skill.py` 检查包格式。
